tei:div.tei:p: (ka)༄༅// lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i man ngag gi byung tshul gsung ngag rin po che bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyi 'od bzhugs so// lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i man ngag gi byung tshul gsung ngag bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyi 'od ces bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// dge legs thugs rje'i rin chen khams las grub// rgya chen mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rab tu rgyas// rnam dag phrin las 'od zer stong 'phro ba// rje btsun bla ma nam mkha'i nor bu rgyal// lam mchog mthar thug gsung ngag rin po che// 'phags pa'i yul dang gangs ri'i khrod dag tu// ji ltar byung dang brgyud pa so so'i srol// ma 'dres go bde'i ngag gis bshad kyis nyon// 'dir bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab mdo sde dang*/ rgyud sde mtha' dag gi nyams len gyi gnad phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas/ skal ldan gyi 'gro ba thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa la 'khrid par byed pa'i thabs/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i mngon par rtogs pa mtha' dag tshang la ma nor bar ston pa ni/ rje btsun bir+wa pas rnam par bkral ba'i lam rgyas pa 'di yin no// 'di 'chad pa la gsum ste/ thog mar man ngag gi byung tshul dang*/ byung ba'i chos la bshad bsgrub bya tshul dang*/ sgrub pa mthar phyin pas gzhan don bya tshul lo// dang po la gnyis te/ rgya gar du byung tshul/ de bod du byon tshul lo// dang po la spyir bstan pa dar tshul/ khyad par lam skor dgu byung tshul/ bye brag tu gsung ngag dar tshul lo// dang po ni 'o skol gyi ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa 'di/ bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas sangs rgyas su zin yang gdul bya'i ngor dzam+bu'i gling du/ tshe lo brgya pa la sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan nas/ gdul bya phar phyin theg pa la mos pa rnams la/ bka' dang po bden pa bzhi/ gnyis pa mtshan nyid med pa/ gsum pa don dam rnam nges las brtsams nas/

chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum du bskor zhing*/ gdul bya zab mo rdo rje theg pa'i lam la mos pa rnams la bya ba dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ rnal 'byor dang*/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa ste/ rgyud sde bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor bas/ gdul bya rnams rang rang gi lam dang 'bras bu la bkod nas/ mthar grong khyer rtswa mchog gi shing sā la zung cig gi tshal du/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan nas/ de'i rjes su de nyid kyi bstan pa yun ring du gnas te/ sems can la phan bde 'byung ba yin no// de'ang 'bras bu'i dus lnga brgya pa phrag gsum/ bsgrub pa'i dus lnga brgya pa phrag gsum/ lung gi dus lnga brgya pa phrag gsum ste/ lnga brgya pa phrag dgu/ rtags tsam 'dzin pa lnga brgya pa phrag gcig ste/ lnga brgya pa phrag bcur gnas par gsungs pa las/ 'bras bu'i dus la rgyun zhugs/ dgra bcom/ phyir 'ong*/ phyir mi 'ong thob pa mang*/ sgrub pa'i dus la zhi lhag sgom pa dang*/ tshul khrims dang ldan pa mang*/ lung gi dus sde snod gsum so sor spyod pa mang bar gsungs/ de las sngon skye dgu'i bdag mo rab tu byung bas/ lo lnga brgya 'grib ste/ de'i lhag ma rnams phal cher rgya gar du gnas pas/ sangs rgyas byon/ chos gsung*/ bka' bsdus pas bstan pa dar ba'i yul rgya gar dbus yin la/ der khrims gnyis ka shin tu dar ba byung ba yin zhing*/ dgra bcom pa dang*/ lan cig phyir 'ong*/ phyir mi 'ong rgyun zhugs te 'bras bu bzhi thob pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams dang*/ rgyan drug mchog brgyad dang*/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha/ grub chen ku ku ri pa la sogs pa mdo sngags kyi shing rta'i srol 'byed kyi mkhas pa rnams dang*/ gzhan yang mkhas pa dang*/ grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes bu du ma byon nas bstan pa yun ring du gnas par mdzad pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/ 'phags pa'i yul gyi paṇa grub rnams rnal 'byor bla med kyi gdams ngag la mchog tu 'dzin cing*/

nyams len yang bskyed rdzogs gnyis la mdzad pa sha stag go /rnal 'byor bla med kyi gdams ngag la/ zab cing khungs thub pa'i lam skor dgu zhes grags te/ de yang bla ma rdo rje gdan pas/ chu bo chen po gyen la bzlog /chang la nyi ma gteng par bcug /bir+wa pa zhes bya ba yi// bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod pa'i slob dpon rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis/ rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa dang*/ sam+bu ṭi la sogs pa'i rgyud la brten nas/ rdo rje bdag med ma'i bka' bzhin du/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i man ngag gsal bar mdzad do// de bzhin du/ zla ba'i rigs la dngos grub brnyes// pad+ma can dang lhan cig bzhugs// mtsho skyes rdo rje zhes bya ba// bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod pa'i slob dpon pad+ma badz+ras/ brtag gnyis la brten nas/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes dang*/ mar me'i rtse mo lta bu'i rdzogs rim brtsams/ de'i man ngag bskyed rim zab pa'i tshul dgus zab pa/ bsnyen sgrub bzhi'i cho ga'i yan lag cha dbri ba dang bcas pa mdzad do// yang*/ dge slong lus la dngos grub brnyes// nags kyi lha mos bdud rtsi phul// klu sgrub snying po zhes bya ba'i// bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod pa'i slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi rnam grangs byang chub kyi sems la brten nas/ byang chub sems 'grel brtsams/ de'i don/ mchod rten gyi drung du sems thag bcad pa'i man ngag mdzad do// yang*/ gding pa btings nas gaṅgā brgal// stag la zhon nas dngos grub brnyes// ḍom+bhi he ru ka zhes bya// bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod pa'i slob dpon ḍom+bhi he ru kas/ brtag gnyis la brten nas/ lhan cig skyes grub brtsams/ de'i don lhan cig skyes pa gsum gyis lam rdzogs pa'i man ngag mdzad do// yang*/ rgyal rigs u rgyan gnas na bzhugs// lcam sring gnyis kyis dngos grub brnyes// in+d+ra bhū ti zhes bya ba'i// bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod pa'i rgyal po īn+d+ra bhū tis/

ye shes thig le'i rgyud la brten nas/ dbang yon tan rim pa brtsams/ de'i don phyag rgyas lam rdzogs pa'i man ngag mdzad do// yang*/ thar bu'i lus la shing mkhan rigs// mu dra ma dang dngos grub brnyes// tog tse pa zhes bya ba yi// bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod pa'i slob dpon tog tse pas/ sam+bu ṭi la brten nas/ bsam mi khyab pa brtsams/ de'i don bsam mi khyab pa lngas lam rdzogs pa mdzad do// yang*/ bla ma'i bka' bcag spyod pa mdzad// srid pa bar dor rdzogs sangs rgyas// nag po spyod pa zhes bya ba'i// bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod pa'i slob dpon nag po spyod pas/ bde mchog la brten nas/ o la pa ti brtsams/ de'i don gtum mo lam rdzogs pa'i man ngag mdzad do// yang*/ rgyal rigs nyi mi'i zer la gshegs// ril bu sa 'og mig sman spyod// ngag gi dbang phyug ces bya ba'i// bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod pa'i slob dpon ngag dbang grags pas/ gsang 'dus dang brtag gnyis gnyis ka la brten nas/ bzhi pa snang ba/ yan lag bdun ldan/ de kho na nyid rin po che'i phreng ba ste gzhung gsum brtsams/ de'i don phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa'i gdams ngag mdzad do// yang*/ dka' thub bor nas spyod pa mdzad// lta stangs mdzad cing dngos grub brnyes// nag po pa zhes bya ba yi// bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod pa'i rnal 'byor pa nag po u tsi tra 'chi ba med pas/ ma rgyud mtha' dag gi man ngag rlung btsan thabs su dbu mar 'jug pa/ yon po srong ba'i man ngag mdzad do// 'di dang o la pa ti mdzad mkhan gyi nag po pa gnyis mi gcig par brgyud pa las shes so// de ltar mdzad mkhan brgyad kyis zer yang*/ dgus mdzad pa'i gdams ngag dgu la lam skor dgur grags so// gsum pa ni/ de ltar lam skor dgu'i nang nas/ slob dpon chen po bir+wa pa'i lam 'di dus ci tsam nas byung snyam na/

sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo bzhi brgya nas 'phags pa klu sgrub byon te lo drug brgya'i bar du bzhugs so// 'phags pa'i sku tshe'i smad kyi slob ma ni/ slob dpon ār+ya de wa yin la/ de'i slob ma ni slob dpon bir+wa pa yin no// zhes dam pa rgya gar gyi man ngag las byung zhing*/ spyan ras gzigs brtul zhugs kyi dbu ma'i 'grel par/ slob dpon 'phags pa lha'i dbu ma bzhi brgya pa la/ slob dpon 'dis 'grel pa mdzad par bshad do// yang*/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo dgu brgya nas 'phags pa thogs med byon par mkhan po wa na brtsegs kyis bshad la/ lo ni brgya dang lnga bcur 'tsho// zhes 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud du dgung lo phyed dang nyis brgya bzhugs par bshad do// de'i slob ma slob dpon chos skyong yin par mdo sde sa bcu pa'i brgyud pa las 'byung ngo*// des na ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo stong dang nyi shu tsam 'das pa na slob dpon 'di byon par mngon te/ dbu ma rang rgyud pa rnams kyi lugs la/ klu sgrub dang ye shes snying po gnyis kyi bar na legs ldan byed dang dpal sbas gnyis las med la/ ye shes snying pos slob dpon 'di phyogs sngar bkod pa'i phyir na sngar smos pa'i dus de shin tu rigs pa yin no// gza' yum gyi mdo'i brgyud pa la ni/ bir+wa pa'i dngos slob slob dpon zhi ba 'tsho yin par bshad la/ de ltar na zhi 'tsho lo stong lnga brgya dang gcig thub par grags la/ slob dpon de rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis bsam yas kyi rab gnas la lug gi lor spyan drangs/ lo de nyid kyi dpyid zla ra ba'i yar ngo la 'khon klu'i dbang po sogs sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung bar bshad pas dus 'grigs par snang ngo*// gzhan yang mtshan brjod kyi 'grel pa zla ba bzang po grags pa'i dpal gyis mdzad pa las/ 'jam dpal sangs rgyas ye shes dang*// pad+ma yan lag med pa dang*// sgeg pa bzhad pa'i rdo rje dang*// gsung gi myu gu mgrin gsum dang*// in+d+ra bhū ti legs gsung dang*// chos skyong dang ni dpal sbas dang*// ye shes bshes gnyen ye shes grags// tri bi kra ma chos dbang po// dpal ldan dbang phyug zla bzang dpal// 'di dag brgyud pa'i rim pa las// bdag gis 'grel pa 'di brtsams pas// 'jam dpal go 'phang thob par shog

/ces 'byung ngo*// de lta bu'i slob dpon gnas brtan chos skyong shing rta'i srol 'byed chen po de la/ sprul pa'i sku rdo rje bdag med mas dbang bskur zhing*/ rgyud sde rin po che gdams ngag dang bcas pa byin pas sa drug pa la gnas pa'i sems dpa' chen por gyur to// phyis spyod pa mdzad pa na dpal bir+wa pa zhes grags so// grub chen 'di 'phags yul gyi slob dpon phyi ma mang pos dpang por byas pa zhig ste/ slob dpon thub pa byin dang*/ grub thob dpa' bo 'od gsal dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta dar+pan ā tsar+ya rnams kyis 'di'i man ngag rnams khungs su drangs nas bshad pa byas pa'i phyir ro// grub chen des dbang bskur rgyud bshad/ man ngag byin nas byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa'i slob dpon shar phyogs nag po pa ste/ slob dpon 'di yang shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ shar phyogs kyi rgyal po zhig btsun mo'i tshogs bdun cu rtsa gnyis la chags nas/ des 'khor bar 'ching bar 'dug pa la/ rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen cig dang phrad na/ grol bar 'dug pa mkhyen nas/ rgyal po de'i btsun mo'i tshogs su zhugs pa dang*/ de nyug rum pa dang*/ blon po'i tshogs gcig nas gcig tu bsrings te/ rgyal po'i snyan du byung ba dang*/ rgyal po na re/ de la chad pa chod cig zer/ der rgyal po'i 'khor mi phyin pa dang*/ slob dpon gzung yul 'gags pa'i stobs kyis/ nang du phyin tsam na thogs pa med par phyir song*/ phyir phyin tsa na nang du yong ba la/ phyi nang gnyis ka dmag gis bkang bas slob dpon gcig la gnyis su song ba las/ tha ma brgya nyi shu rtsa brgyad du song ste/ gang la brdeg cha med du song ba las/ rgyal pos gser gyi cod paṇa phud de/ zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ rjes su bzung bar zhus pas/ lus po rim gyis bsdus te/ rtsa ba'i sku lus gcig tu gyur nas rgyal po de rjes su bzung*/

rig pa mkhas pas sems ma rtogs pas/ tha snyad mkhan la ngo mtshar med/ srin byed rang gi gzugs ma mthong bas/ gzhan mthong ba la ngo mtshar med/ e ma mkha' la 'gro ba'i bya de lam dang rjes la dmigs mi 'gyur// bde chen de bzhin nyid 'di tha snyad sgras mi mtshon// e ma mkhas pa snying re rje// rang la yod nas gzhan du tshol// bu shi ba yi mya ngan bzhin// dpag med bsgrub kyang 'grub mi 'gyur// phyag rgya chen po rang la lhun gyis grub pa ste// mi bsam 'bad med rig pa ngang la zhog /chad par mi 'gyur rig pa ngang gis nyams su myong*// rtag par mi 'gyur mngon zhen med par zung du chud// ces tshigs bcad de rnams gsungs pas/ rgyal po la rtogs pa khyad par can skyes nas/ 'khor dang bcas pa grol bar byas so// zhes zha ma lugs kyi gzhung bshad/ spang rje nyi ma grags kyis byas pa las 'byung ngo*// des grub chen ḍā ma ru pa la byin gyis brlabs shing gdams te/ slob dpon 'dis kyang*/ mu stegs 'dul ba'i don du/ smyon pa'i brtul zhugs mdzad nas/ phyag g.yas pas stag mi zan gyi mgrin pa nas bzung*/ g.yon pas mu stegs kyi rgyal po'i skra nas bzung ste/ khur du khur nas byon pas mu stegs kyi 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa phyi bzhin 'brengs shing gus 'dud byas nas/ de thams cad sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bkod do// zhes 'brom lugs las 'byung ngo*// slob dpon des grub chen a wa dhū tī pa la gdams te/ slob dpon 'di yang bhu su ku'i spyod pa skyong zhing*/ sku gcer bur bzhugs pa la bā ra ṇa sī'i byis pa lnga brgyas sku la co 'dri zhing rtsed mo rtse bas 'gro ba mang po'i don mdzad do// de ltar nag po pa/ ḍā ma ru pa/ a wa dhū tī pa ste gsum po 'dis/ de kho na nyid rtogs par rje btsun gyis bshad pas/ sa dang po yan chad la gnas pa'i 'phags par grub bo// des grub chen ga ya dha ra la gdams te/

kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob nas/ nub gsum du dbang gi ye shes bskyangs pas/ sbyor lam chos mchog chen po'i ting nge 'dzin skyes/ ḍā ma ru bar snang la bzhag pas rang dkrol du 'byung ba dang*/ gdugs yu ba med par nam mkha' la bzhag pas rang 'khor du 'byung ba sogs kyis yon tan dpag tu med pa yod ces 'brom lugs su 'byung ngo*// gsang 'dus 'gos lugs pa rnams slob dpon 'di dang rgyal po sprin gyi shugs can gnyis gcig par bzhed la/ de ltar na/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pas/ rgyal rigs rig pa'i gnas lnga mkhas// nam mkha'i lha la the tshom gcod// sprin gyi shugs can zhes bya ba'i// bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i nang du bgrangs pas/ phyis ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pas bden pa mthong ba yan chad kyi rtogs pa skyes par the tshom med do// de ltar 'phags yul gyi grub chen de dag gis/ bshad sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas/ gsung ngag rin po che dar zhing rgyas par byas so// gnyis pa bod du byon tshul la gsum las/ dang po bstan pa spyi'i byon tshul la gsum ste/ dang po bstan pa snga dar gyi lo rgyus ni/ 'o na bstan pa de bod du ci tsam na byung snyam na/ bod mtha' 'khob yin pas sngon khrims gnyis ka med de/ zas su ri dwags kyi sha za/ pags pa gos su gyon/ dge sdig gi bye brag gang yang mi shes shing*/ rang dgar sil bur gnas pas yun ring por chos kyi ming tsam yang ma byung ngo*// bod 'di gang las 'phel snyam na/ sngon rgya gar du khyab 'jug dang 'thab dka' 'gras te/ khyab 'jug gis skya bseng gi phyogs byas te/ g.yul byas pa na/ srid sgrub kyis kho bo'i nye du'i tshogs gsod mi nus zhes smras pa dang*/ khyab 'jug gis/ gang gis mi ni bsad pa dang*// gang gis gsod par byed pa dag /de dag gnyis ka mi rigs te// gsod dang gsod pa yod min te// rigs dang 'dul ba phun sum tshogs// bram ze ba glang glang po dang*// khyi dang sme sha can dag dang*// mkhas pa rnams ni mnyam par blta// zhes sogs med lta'i tshig dang*/

gzugs sna tshogs pa bstan pas bslus nas/ srid sgrub kyi kha lo khyab 'jug gis byas te/ g.yul bkye bas 'thab dka' rigs dpung tshogs bco brgyad dang bcas pa brlag par byas so// de'i tshe ru pa rti zhes bya ba rgyal po dpung tshogs dang bcas pa bud med kyi chas su byas te bros nas ri kha ba can du gnas pa'i rigs/ deng sang yang bod ces grags pa yin no// zhes lha las phul byung gi 'grel pa shes rab go chas byas pa las bshad do// de lta bu'i bod 'dir/ lha mo dri ma med pa'i 'od lung bstan pa'i mdor/ nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya nas/ gdong dmar can gyi yul du dam pa'i chos dar bar 'gyur ro// zhes lung bstan pa ltar/ lo de tsam na bstan pa dbu brnyes nas/ rgyal po mes dbon rnam gsum gyi ring la dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes/ srol btod/ dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ ces deng sang gi bar gtam du grags pa yin no// tshul ji ltar na/ lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi pho brang gi steng du mdo za ma tog bkod pa/ gser gyis bris pa'i/ dpang skong phyag brgya pa/ gser gyi mchod rten khru gang pa/ tsin+dha ma ṇi'i brkos phor rnams phyag tu byung ba las/ gang yin ngo ma shes kyang*/ yid du 'ong bas ming gnyan po gsang ba zhes bya bar btags nas/ phyag mchod byas pas/ rgyal srid mnga' thang cher rgyas te 'phel bas dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes so// de nas rgyal rabs lnga na/ srong btsan sgom po'i ring la rgya gar gyi yi ge mkhas pa li byin gdan drangs nas/ glang khams pa go cha dang*/ thon mi sam+bho ṭa gnyis kyis bod kyi yi ge brtsams/ skad la skad dod btsal te/ dam chos bsgyur du btub mi btub lta ba'i ched du sgrung la sogs pa bsgyur bas btub par go nas/ mdo za ma tog bkod pa/ pad+ma dkar po/ tsin+dha ma ṇi/ 'dus pa rin po che tog gzungs/ rgyal po mdo lnga la sogs pa mang du bsgyur/

lha khang mang du bzhengs/ chos dge ba bcu spel zhing gtan khrims rnam pa lnga bcas/ bshad nyan gyi srol dang chos grwa mang du btsugs nas dam pa'i chos kyi srol btod/ phyis gdung rabs lnga na chos dar ba lung bstan te/ de nas gdung rab lnga la rgyal po khri srong sde'u btsan byon nas/ de'i ring la slob dpon zhi ba 'tsho dang pad+ma gdan drangs nas/ slob dpon pad+mas bod kyi lha 'dre gdug pa can rnams btul/ bsam yas bzhengs pa'i sa chog mdzad/ slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos rab gnas mdzad/ gzhan yang paṇ+ḍi ta sangs rgyas gsang ba dang*/ mkhan po dā na shī la dang*/ dharma kīrti/ ka ma la shī la dang*/ bi ma la mi tra dang*/ shī len+d+ra bo dhi la sogs pa mang po gdan drangs nas/ gzhon nu blo gsal ba rnams la sgra dang lots+tsha slob du bcug pa las/ thog mar lots+tsha ba sad mi mi bdun bya ba byung ste/ de la rgan gsum ni/ dbas rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ rin chen bsrung ba zhes bya ba bod yul du btsun pa byung ba la snga ba mkhan po bo dhi satwa sku gshegs nas 'dis mkhan po byas pa yin no// rba dz+nyā nen+d+ra rak+ṣi ta/ ye shes dbang po bsrung ba ste/ dam pa'i chos 'byin pa'i mkhan po bod la sku drin che ba yin zhing*/ sangs rgyas kyis kyang byang chub sems dpa' rta skad ces par lung bstan pa thob pa yin no// rat+ne n+d+ra rak+ṣi ta/ rin chen dbang po bsrung ba ste gsum mo// bar pa ni/ glang su ga ta warma rak+ṣi ta bde bar gshegs pa'i go cha bsrung ba zhes bya'o// gzhon gsum ni/ pa gor bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta/ rnam par snang mdzad bsrung ba zhes bya ba dang*/ 'khon nā gen+d+ra rak+ṣi ta/ klu'i dbang po bsrung ba zhes bya ba dang*/ gtsang de wen+d+ra rak+ṣi ta/ lha'i dbang po bsrung ba dang gsum mo// sad mi mi bdun la/ ska ba shrī ku ṭa rak+ṣi ta/ dpal brtsegs bsrung ba la sogs pa/ lots+tsha ba che ba brgya rtsa brgyad kyi sa bla sbyangs la/ de dag la cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan la sogs pa lots+tsha ba stong rtsa brgyad kyis blo sbyong mdzad do// zhes sngon gyi bka' chems kyi yi ge rnying pa las 'byung ngo*// de rnams kyis sgra bsgyur dang zhu chen dang mchan bu'i lots+tsha byas nas/

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pa mdo mang po dang*/ rnam snang mngon byang la sogs pa bya spyod kyi rgyud dang*/ de nyid 'dus pa la sogs pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la sogs pa sngags ci rigs pa dang*/ sgrub thabs mang du bsgyur/ de nas bzung ste dam pa'i chos dar zhing rgyas par byas so// khri srong lde'u btsan la sras bzhi byung ba'i che ba gsum grongs/ chung shos khri lde srong btsan/ sad na legs mjing yon du grags pa des/ skar chung lha khang bzhengs/ paṇ+ḍi ta bi ma la mi tra/ ka ma la shī la/ dz+nyā na se na/ bal po hūm̐ ka ra rnams bteg ste/ 'khon klu'i dbang po bsrung ba/ rma rin chen mchog ye shes sde/ bran kha nam mkha'/ gtsang pa de byin rnams kyis lots+tsha byas te/ chos sngar ma bsgyur ba mang po bsgyur/ bsgyur ba rnams skad gsar bcad kyis bcos te gtad la phab/ chos grwa dang sgom grwa mang du btsugs/ bod 'bangs rnams bde la bkod de/ dam pa'i chos rgyas par byas so// des la sras gtsang ma/ dar ma/ ral pa can bya ba gsum byung bas gtsang ma rab tu byung*/ dar ma rang rgyud ngan pas sems can la gnod kyis dogs nas rgyal srid ma gtad par/ khri lde gtsug brtan la ral pa can du grags pa de lo bcu gnyis la yab 'das nas de la rgyal srid gtad/ de'i ring la 'on cang rdo bzhengs/ mkhan po pradz+nyā warma dang*/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ su ren+d+ra bo dhi la sogs pa mang po dang*/ lots+tsha ba ska ba dpal brtsegs dang*/ cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan/ zhang sna nam/ ye shes sde rnams kyis chos mang po bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab nas dam pa'i chos shin tu dar zhing rgyas par byas so// gnyis pa bar du 'grib pa'i tshul ni/ ral pa can grongs pa'i rjes su/ dar mas rgyal srid bzung ste/ thog mar rgyal srid chos bzhin du bskyangs pa las/ bar skabs su khong gi thugs su gdon gsol/ jo bo shākya mu ne bye thems su sbas/

sngags kyi rgyud sde rnams rgya gar du bskyal/ pu sti mchod cha rnams mun khung du sbas/ paṇ+ḍi ta rnams rgya gar du log rab tu byung ba la la bkrongs/ la la rta zhon pa'i stegs byas/ la la phab nas rnga gshang bskur te bya dang ri dwags rngon pa la bskos nas/ dbus gtsang gi bstan pa nyams shing ming tsam yang med par byas/ de'i dus na 'dul ba la lag len ni ngal zhing dub pa'i mthar ltung ba tsam byung*/ bshad pa'i bka' shin tu ngan te/ rtsa ba dmar dmar 'di 'grel pa nag nag 'dis 'chad pa 'dra zer ba tsam las ma byung*/ byang sems kyi'ang sems bskyed kyi bka' tsho nub/ gsang sngags la'ang chags lam dang drag po mngon spyod kyi lag len dar ba cig byung*/ de'i tshe yab mes kyi chos khrims dang*/ rgyal khrims gnyis ka brlag par byas pas/ lkog tu gsang nas nyams su len pa re tsam min pa dngos su chos bya sa med nas/ grom pa rgyang nas bros sam yang zer ba'i gtsang g.yo dmar gsum gyis/ res cig chu bo rir gab nas bzhugs/ de nas khong rnams kyis 'dul ba mdo rtsa 'od ldan/ las chog karma sha taṃ/ mngon pa mdzod la sogs pa dpe dre'u khal gcig bkal/ btsun chas bsgyur nas dwags kong nas brgyud de bros pas mdo smad du thar ro// de dus na yer pa'i drag la lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes sgrub pa mdzad kyin yod pa la/ yer pa'i ri la rab tu byung ba'i gzugs kyis rnga dang rol mo khyer nas ri dwags 'dod pa mthong nas/ ci yin dris pas rgyu mtshan bshad pa dang*/ chos kyi bstan pa nyams pa la ma bzod nas/ 'phan yul la bskor te sgo lar byon nas lha sar slebs pa dang*/ bran mo chu len cig la rgyal po bzhugs sam mjal ba yin byas pas/ bzhugs yod dar gcig nas gla ba'i tshal gseb du skyo bsangs la 'byon gyin yod zer ba dang*/ rta dkar po ber dkar po mdung dkar po la sol bas byugs nas/ mi nag rtag nag mdung nag can du byas te phyin pas rgyal po gdong bsil mig mang rtse zhing yod pa la/

yid ma bde nas rdo rings kyi yi ge klog gin yod pas/ mgon po nag po byung zer/ rtsar phyin nas zhe sa byed pa skad byas te/ lcags mda' brgyab kyang zer/ mdung bsnun kyang zer te/ gang ltar yang mtshon bsnun pas/ rgyal po na re/ yang na lo gsum gyis sngas/ yang na lo gsum gyis phyis zer ro// de nas lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes gtsang po brgal nas byon pas/ sol ba dag ste/ mi dkar rta dkar mdung dkar can gcig tu byas te nga gnas thel dkar po yin zer zhing byon to// 'o rgyal thang la nub mo gzims nas tho rangs yer par byon/ pe'u dmar ser du bya rgod kyi thul pa gsol/ nye 'khor rnams su rdul dang dud pa gtor/ de'i steng du mug pa mang po btang nas/ phong phul le/ rdul khad de/ mug rjes lam me bzhugs pas/ mi rnams na re rgyal po sdig can la lha ma srin rnams kyis chad pa phog nas bkrongs so zer/ blon po dang rjes gcod rnams kyis 'ong nas mthong bas/ rgyal po bkrongs mkhan lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje bya ba'i mi ma 'phrul 'di yin pa 'dra ste/ snyad ma rnyed zer nas log gin song skad/ de nas khong rgya nag tu bros pas thar/ mdor na khong gi nus pa dang g.yo thabs kyis rgyal po bkrongs kyang bstan pa nyams ches pa'i shugs kyis bstan pa 'phel ba dang dar ba ni yun ring gi bar du ma byung ngo*// //gsum pa bstan pa phyi dar gyi lo rgyus la stod nas dang*/ smad nas bstan pa ji ltar dar ba'i tshul gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od dang*/ jo bo rin chen bzang pos bstan pa'i me ro stod nas bslangs pa yin te/ tshul ji ltar na/ dar ma'i sras khri dar ma 'od srungs dang*/ khri sde yum brtan gnyis byung*/ 'od srungs kyi sras/ mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan/ de'i sras bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal dang*/ skyid lde nyi ma mgon gnyis/ nyi ma mgon mnga' ris su spyugs pa la/ sras dpal gyi mgon/

lde gtsug mgon/ bkra shis mgon gsum byung*/ stod kyi mgon gsum mo// smad du bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal la sras dpal lde 'od lde skyid lde gsum byung nas smad kyi lde gsum mo// de rnams kyis stod smad so so mnga' ris bzung bas/ stod du rgyal khrims zhwa tsam cig chags pa mnga' ris skor gsum mo// smad du rgyal khrims l+h+wam tsam cig chags pa dbus gtsang ru bzhi'o// bkra shis mgon gyis sku mkhar nyi bzur bzung nas/ pu hrang*/ zhang zhung*/ gu ge glo bo/ dol po/ ya tshe la sogs pa la mnga' mdzad/ de'i sras 'od kyi rgyal mtshan/ de'i sras srong nge dang 'khor nge*/ srong nge rab tu byung ba lha bla ma ye shes 'od ces bya/ khong gis yab mes kyi gdung bsab cing sems can la phan gdags par dgongs nas/ mnga' ris stod kyi byis pa lo bcu gsum las mi gzhon mi rgan pa rnams bsags nas/ chu tshod dang*/ dbyu gu dang*/ gzhung 'dzin pa dang*/ gzhung gi don rnams la blo rim gyis rtog tu bcug nas/ de rnams kyis nang nas blo rab tu gyur pa'i shes rab can bdun/ de'i g.yog bdun/ yang g.yog blo dang gros la sogs pa yod pa bdun te/ nyi shu rtsa gcig la gser mang po bskur nas rgya gar kha cher slob gnyer la brdzangs pas las kyi dbang gis bcu dgu shi/ bod la phan thogs pa lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang po dang*/ de'i g.yog lo chung legs pa'i shes rab gnyis las ma byung*/ de gnyis kyis chos mang po bslabs nas 'ongs te/ bod du mdo bstan bcos/ sde snod/ mtshan nyid/ sngags phyi nang gi rgyud 'brel la sogs pa'i chos mang po bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab nas/ dam pa'i chos rnams rim gyis 'phel zhing dar bar byas so// gnyis pa ni/ dbus gtsang gi bstan pa nyams dma' nas dus yun ring shig nas sngar dbus gtsang nas bros pa'i g.yo dge 'byung gis mkhan po/ gtsang rab gsal gyis slob dpon/ dmar shākya mu nes gsang ston pa/

rgya'i hwa shang king waṃ dang*/ king phag gnyis kyis kha bskangs byas nas/ mdo smad en chung gi dgon pa yang zer ba'i/ dan tig shel gyi yang dgon yang zer ba der rab tu byung ba la/ bla chen mu thur dgongs pa rab gsal bya ba byung ste/ de la lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug tshang tsho shes rab seng ge 'bre btsun rgyal ba byang chub ste gtsang pa gsum/ dbus pa klu mes 'phags pa'i shes rab ste bzhi'am/ sum ye shes blo ste dbus gtsang gi mi lngas rab tu byung ste dbus gtsang du byon nas/ rab tu byung ba mang po'i mkhan po mdzad/ dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs bstan pa dar bar mdzad do// de'i tshe na snga ma gnyis la lo tshang gnyis phyi ma gnyis la 'bring sde rnam gnyis 'byung ste/ deng sang gi bar du sde pa phal che ba lo tsho/ tshang tsho/ 'bring tsho gsum las gyes par grags so// //gnyis pa bye brag tu lam skor dgu 'phel tshul ni/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi tshe lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gi mkhan bu rgya shākya gzhon nu dang*/ se ye shes brtson 'grus gnyis kyi slob ma 'brog mi lots+tsha ba chen po shākya ye shes rgya gar du byon nas/ slob dpon shān+ti pa la sogs pa'i mkhas grub mang po las mdo sngags kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhus shing bsgyur/ bye brag tu bir+wa pa'i lam 'bras/ pad+ma pa'i lam/ mchod rten drung thob/ gtum mo lam rdzogs/ yon po srong ba/ bsam mi khyab rnams dge slong dpa' bo rdo rje dang*/ rje ga ya dha ra las rgya gar shar phyogs dang bod yul du zhus shing bsgyur/ yi ge med pa a mo gha badz+ra las bod du dar/ in+d+ra bhū ti'i lam/ paṇ+ḍi ta shes rab gsang ba las bod du zhus shing bsgyur te dar bar byas so// mdor na lam skor re'i gzhung pa tshab lots+tsha ba dang*/ 'gos la sogs pa lots+tsha ba tha dad kyis bsgyur ba du ma yod kyang*/ lam skor dgu'i gzhung man ngag dang bcas pa phyogs gcig tu bsgyur nas bod du dar bar mdzad pa ni/

rje btsun 'brog mi lots+tsha ba kho na yin no// //gsum pa sgos su gsung ngag byung tshul la gsum/ dang po grub chen ga ya dha ras srol btod tshul/ bar du bla chen 'brog mi dpon slob kyis spel tshul/ mthar rje btsun sa skya pa rnams kyis dar bar byas tshul lo// dang po ni/ grub chen ga ya dha ra bod du lan gsum byon pa'i dang po bla chen 'brog mi la/ bir+wa pa'i lam rgyas pa la sogs pa man ngag dang rgyud 'grel du ma gdams te/ 'di'i tshul rgyas par 'og tu 'chad do// bar pa rje 'gos lots+tsha ba chen pos spyan drangs pa'i tshe lam 'bras ni ma gnang mod/ 'on kyang kye rdo rje'i rgyud gsum 'grel pa dang*/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung che phra mang du bsgyur zhing bshad nas/ kye rdo rje 'gos lugs su grags pa dar po byung snang mod/ deng sang de nas brgyud pa chad nas mi snang ngo*// tha ma gyi jo lots+tsha ba spyan drangs so// ma rgyud kyi rgyud 'grel mang po bsgyur cing bshad nas dar bar byas/ lam 'bras ni ma gsungs so// zhes 'brom lugs pa dang*/ zhwa ma lugs rnams zer yang*/ gsung ngag gi gdams ngag rdzogs pa zhig yod par snang ste/ gyi jos bsgyur ba'i rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang dang*/ gyi jo'i slob brgyud rnams kyis byas pa'i brgyud pa'i lo rgyus/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi 'grel pa rgyas pa bsdus don/ bha ga'i yi ge bcu bzhi'i man ngag rnams snang zhing man ngag rdzogs pa'i yig cha yod par snang ngo*// de ltar na gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer/ zhu 'khor lo/ zhu dar ma rgyal mtshan/ zhu ston hor mo/ 'od pa don ne/ mchims tshul khrims shes rab rnams kyis bar du brgyud nas mang du 'phel mod/ deng sang yig cha tsam las brgyud pa zin pa mi 'dug go/ //gnyis pa ni/ rje btsun 'brog mi la/ gzhung tshar ba/ man ngag tshar ba/ grub pa thob pa'i slob ma rnams yod pa las/ man ngag tshar ba'i slob ma ni/

'brom de ba ston chung*/ lha btsun ka li/ rje se mkhar chung ba dang gsum las med do// de la lam 'bras 'brom lugs su grags pa yin/ 'brom tsan+d+ra warti zhes bya ba mdo smad kyi mi chen cig yin zer ba 'brom lugs rang gi lo rgyus na snang la/ bla ma dmar gyis ni 'phan yul ba yin gsung*/ gang ltar rigs dang skyes shin tu bzang longs spyod che/ gdams ngag mang zhing khyad par du ma mo srog thig la mkhas pa cig yin/ khong gi bla chen gyi snyan pa'i grags pa thos nas dad de yul na rta bdun gyi khal du yon mang po bkal nas/ klag pa lam gyi yul nas bsam yas la thon te byon pas/ lam du lha mo'i sgrub thabs zhu ba mang ba byung*/ nor mang po byung ba khyer te 'ongs nas bla chen gyi drung du gdams ngag zhu ba la/ chos thun re la gser zho re'i maṇ+ḍal zhabs dkris la dar zhing can kha re phul te/ de dus kyi dar bzang zhing dkon pas/ da lta'i zab chen yug bas rin che skad/ de bzhin du gtor ma mi gnyis kyis theg tshad re tshogs 'khor re byas/ 'brog mi'i g.yu zho spungs kyang zer ba phul bas shin tu mnyes/ de ltar dus khyad par can dang nar ma'i bsnyen bkur dpag tu med pa yun ring du mdzad de/ zhabs tog shin tu che bas gdams ngag rab tu thob pa zer/ nang gcig maṇ+ḍal gyi gser yang zad/ zhabs dkris kyang med pas kho rang gi jo mo'i dar sham phog nas byas pas cung ma mnyes skad/ de ltar longs spyod che ba la/ dar 'bog dang ja sigs dang*/ mdzo rta bsgrigs na/ mdo smad nas mu gu lung gi bar ma chod pa yod skad/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang la rgya gar skad ma bsgyur zhing 'grel pa rgyas par byas/ rgya blo grags la sogs pa'i slob ma mang po la bshad do// sku tshe'i mjug tu la stod la 'byon pa'i lam kar mu gu lung du bla chen dang mjal/ 'bul ba mang du byas nas/ dpe 'gel ba'i rta gcig g.yar bar zhus pas/ slob dpon gyis slob ma la 'bul ba byed pa'i lugs med gsungs nas ma gnang bas/

'brom rje thugs ched bzhud kar mu gu lung rdo rje gdan du song rung*/ 'brog mi shākya thub par song yang*/ da phyin chad 'di kun tu 'ong btub pa mi 'dug gsung skad/ de nas la stod ding ri shed nas yar byon pas 'brog mi'i slob ma mchog yin zer bas bsod nams chen po byung nas/ lam du slob ma 'ga' zhig yi ge med pa'i byin rlabs zhu ba byung nas byas pas/ zhal nas khrag skyugs nas bsnyung nad kyis zin/ 'brom na re/ nga'i bla ma de sangs rgyas dngos yin zhing*/ nga'i snod rtog par 'dug pa la/ ngas de ltar ma shes par ma dad pa gcig skyes pas lan/ 'on kyang bla mas rjes su 'dzin par 'dug nga'i dpe cha dang nor rdzas btus pa rnams bla ma'i phyag tu phul/ khyed rang tsho gdams ngag zhu na nga'i dka' las tsam mi dgos par bla mas gnang bar 'dug gi zhus gsungs nas 'das/ slob ma kun gyis pur bzhus/ gdung rus/ dpe cha/ nor rdzas rta bdun gyi bla khal 'og khal khyer phyin pas/ lam bgrod dkar yang bde bar thon/ mu gu lung gi mda' na yar sleb tsa na/ dung dkar gcig 'bud kyin phyin pas/ bla chen rgyun gtor mdzad pas gsan nas nga'i snying bton pa snyam byed ltos dang gsungs/ bltas pas khong gi slebs nas de rnams phul bas/ rus pa pang du blangs nas/ bu pha can bsnyags sam gsungs nas bshum skad/ der khyed tsho'i nang na gdams ngag 'dod pa gang yod pa la/ dka' ba med par sbyin gyis gsung ba la/ zhu ba mang po ma byung*/ sgyer se'o// gshed sgom rog po/ 'phags pa chos snang gsum gyis zhus pas rdzogs par gnang ste/ bsgoms pas ting nge 'dzin bzang por skyes/ se rog gnyis kyis dngos grub cung zad re thob skad do// de nas 'brom de pa ston chung*/ rgya lho brag pa/ chab ston chos dga'/ nyang khams khung pa/ rog sgom pa/ brag pa sku mched/ zla ba rgyal mtshan/ rtog ldan gnam lding ba'i bar du brgyud nas rdo rje'i tshig rkang*/

kye rdor man ngag lugs kyi dbang chu/ man ngag gi yig chung pu sti chung ba gcig snang ngo*// yang 'brom gyis rgya blo gros grags la/ des rgya ston rdo rje seng ge la/ des dar ma grags la/ des khams khung pa la/ des sgro ston shākya 'od rnams la brgyud nas gzhung bshad shin tu rgyas pa zhig dang*/ gsang bcu la sogs pa man ngag phra mo pu sti shin tu che ba gcig 'dug go /des na zhi ba mo rdo rjer/ 'brom las lam 'bras 'phel ba med zer ba ni shin tu ma dag par snang ngo*// rje se mkhar chung ba la lam 'bras rab tu thob pa'i slob ma zhang ston sku mched/ 'bring du thob pa zhwa ma lcam sring*/ tha mar thob pa se sgom byang ye rnams byung ngo*// de la lam 'bras zhang lugs su grags pa ni/ rje btsun se mkhar chung ba'i slob ma zhang dgon pa ba/ zhwa ma dkon mchog slob dpon nyang ston/ mkhan po smon mkhar ba'i bar du brgyud cing*/ zhwa ma dkon mchog gi dgon pa ba dang*/ sa skya pa chen po gnyis la zhus so// de las brgyud pa'i gzhung rdo rje'i tshig rkang 'grel pa dang bcas pa/ zhal shes nyer zhi phal mo che/ brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang bcas pa snang ngo*// lam 'bras zhwa ma lugs la/ sngar byon pa mo rgyud dang pho rgyud gnyis/ phyis byung ba bsres pa'i lugs dang gsum las/ dang po lam 'bras zhwa lugs mo rgyud du grags pa ni/ ma cig zhwa ma'i yul/ la stod pha drug gi zhwa ma brgya bzhi'i nang nas/ zhwa ma mi reg bya ba yin/ lcam sring drug yod pa'i gnyis 'og ma lha rje zhwa ma mtshan rgyal mo lcam/ de'i 'og ma ming po zhwa ma chos kyi rgyal po yul la smos na/ rje khum bu ba zhes zer/ lcam mos mo lo bcu bdun pa la/ 'brom ram cha yu ni bya ba can khyim so la byon/ de dang bral nas rma lots+tsha ba chos 'bar gyi jo mo mdzad/ khong grongs nas des rkyen byas te/ snying rlung byung nas mthong snang la sogs nyams kyi mtho dman mang po dang rtag tu byang sems 'dzag pa'i nad byung ba la/

thams cad du gdams ngag gang che dris pas/ ding ri glang 'khor na/ dam pa rgya gar gdams ngag che bar go nas/ dam pa'i sar byon pas dam pa'i zhal nas/ khyod kyis dang po bla ma dbang bskur zhu ba'i dus su dbang yon ma phul bas lan 'dug gsungs pas/ lha rje mas lus longs spyod thams cad phul/ zas nor thams cad bsres/ nga khyod med par byas pa lags mod byas pas/ de khyed kyi ming bos rta gcig rin du zos 'dug gsungs/ de lha rje ma la rgyus med par ming po kun gyis rta gcig rin du blangs 'dug der lha rje mas dam pa la bla ma grongs nas mi bdog ji ltar bgyi zhus pas/ des bzhengs pa'i rten nam 'brel pa med dam/ zhabs tog gyis gsungs nas snye nam mkhar mda' na/ rma yis bzhengs pa'i gnas sar lha khang bya ba yod pa la/ rta gcig khal dang bcas pa dang khrab gcig phul/ rma yi sras mo jo mo dkar yu bya ba la/ g.yag gcig re thul gcig re dmar dar zab dang bcas pa gcig phul yang zer/ phyi rten la bal po nas gañjir gcig blangs nas btsugs kyang zer te/ de ltar byas pas lo gcig gi bar du nad de phan/ de nas sngar bas kyang thu ru song ste/ dam pa la zhus pas/ rgyal khams 'dra bskor/ mdo rgyud 'dra ltos gsungs nas/ lo bdun du mtshams bcad nas mdo rgyud rnyed tshad gzigs kyang ma phan pa/ gnubs yul grong na mar phyin pas lha rje gnub pa'i ban chung kha cig chu kha na/ e ma ngo mtshar la sogs pa dbyangs su gyer gyin 'dug ste/ e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung*// skye ba med las thams cad skye// skyes tsam nyid nas skye ba med// ces zer ba thos nas/ de la nges shes khyad par can skyes pa'i stobs kyis khams drag de nas yang thur song ste dam pa la zhus pas/ rnga cig lag tu gtad nas brdung bya ba'i brda cig mdzad/ brdungs pas skad chen po cig byung*/ gzhan ci yang ma byung ste/

gdams ngag zhus pas/ song cig pa'i brda mdzad de/ phan pa ma byung bas gdams ngag rdugs par thag bcad gsungs/ de dus bla ma se mkhar chung ba mdo mangs bzhengs kyin yod pa'i chos kyi glegs shing bsgrub pa la brin du byon pa'i tshur lam ding ri shar phyogs kyi mkhar chung ba can byon/ mkhar chung ba'i slob ma ding ri skye chags pa khyung po hūm̐ ka ra ba na re/ 'brog mi'i slob ma se kun rig bya ba lam 'bras kyi bdag po/ khams 'dus pa gso ba la shin tu mkhas pa cig byon bdog pas nyid chos mi zhu'am zer te/ lcam sring gnyis kyis rta gcig la yo byad mang po bkal nas mjal du byon/ dang po nas/ khams kyi skyon 'di ltar byung gi lo rgyus bla ma'i snyan du phul bas/ khong l+h+wam 'bur ma cig la tug tug mdzad cing*/ khyed la dang po 'di ltar ma byung ngam/ de nas 'di ltar ma byung ngam gsungs pas/ zhwa ma'i nyams la byung ba tsho dang mthun nas/ rje sangs rgyas bya ba de khyed lags sam zer zhing shin tu yid ches te phyag mang po 'tshal/ bla ma'i zhal nas zhwa chung ma la bsgom 'dug ste gdams ngag mi 'dug se mkhar chung ba la gdams ngag 'dug ste bsgom mi 'dug sprang po the'u 'dis kyang bar chad cig kyang byed ma 'dod gsung*/ der gdams ngag zhus pas/ dbang bskur dgos gsung*/ sngar bla ma rma la dbang thob byas pas/ nga'i chos 'dod na nga rang gi dbang bskur dgos gsung*/ 'o na cha rkyen bsgrubs nas bla ma'i drung du 'ong bar zhu/ bdag gi ming po ston pa cig bdog pas de khrid na mchi'am zhus pas rung gsungs nas/ rje khum bu pa dang lcam sring gnyis nor mang po khyer nas mkhar chung du byon/ 'bul ba 'khor gsum yang dag lan gsum byas/ bla ma mnyes nas dbang bskur/ gegs sel gdams ngag bstan nas bsgom du bcug pas nad drag ste khrid rnams gnang*/ gzhung tshar ba ni ma nyan gsung*/ zhwa ma bas ni/ gsung ngag rags rim cig nyan/

sems tshims nas khong lcam sring 'gro bar 'dug pa la/ bla ma'i zhal nas zhang ston pa la zhwa ma lcam sring 'di pa mi chen du'ang 'dug gdams ngag gi snod du'ang gda'/ khong la gdams ngag 'di rdzogs par sbyin bsam ste/ khong mi bzhugs par 'gro bar 'dug gdams ngag ni ma tshar/ 'o skol gyi brgyud pa 'di'i lugs kyi slob mas ma zhus pa'i bla mas mi bshad pa srol du gda' bas/ khyed kyis gros thob gsungs te/ zhang ston pas/ khyed kyi bla ma la zhabs tog nan cher byas/ bla ma yang mnyes/ thugs la 'dogs par 'dug khyed kyi zhor la yang nged la yang thugs la btags/ da dung gdams ngag lhag ma 'dra yod pa 'dra/ bzhugs nas lhag ma kun gcod par zhu byas pas/ zhwa ma lcam sring na re/ jo bo 'di ci gsung na/ 'bul ba yang 'khor gsum yang dag lan gsum byas/ byang dang ra tshun chad bskor/ jag dmar gyi gos rkyang pa re las med par phul bas/ grang drags nas lam du gnag gi skyibs 'jo yin 'ong*/ ci yod phul nas zhus/ mnyes kyang mnyes/ gdams ngag kyang ma lus par gnang*/ lhag ma yang med par thag chod/ des tshim yang tshims/ lhag ma yod pa skad gsung yang*/ rje'i zhal rdzun gsung ba yin gsungs nas sdod du ma nyan nas song bas/ cung zad ma rdzogs pa nas 'bring du thob pa yin gsung*/ 'on kyang bsgoms pas yon tan khyad par can skyes te/ yi dam gyi lha dpag tu med pa'i zhal gzigs/ kha gdong mas chu chus/ 'ug gdong mas me thong byas pa tsam gyis/ thab tu me lam/ phru bar chu mer gyis 'byung bar byung ngo*// lus gcig la du mar byed pa la sogs rdzu 'phrul gyi zhing gzhan du skad cig gis bgrod par nus pa yin te/ rdo rje gdan du bde bar gshegs pa'i mchod pa la nam mkha' la byon nas/ gan+dho la la skor ba byed pa bod mo'i cha lugs su yod pa kham pa mi nyag lots+tsha bas ngo shes/ 'di la stod ding ri na yod pa'i ma jo zhwa chung ma bya bar 'dug byas pas/

der rgya gar gyi mi thams cad ngo mtshar skyes te/ bram ze rnams kyis shis pa brjod pa yang byas/ a tsa ra gsum bod du chos zhur byung bas/ ma jo'i zhal nas nged mtha' 'khob kyi mi/ sgos bud med kyi skye ba dman pas/ khyed kyi slob dpon mi 'ong gsungs nas gser srang gsum gnang nas chos ma gnang skad/ nyin cig khog sna na/ dge bshes ldong ston pa chos gsung gin yod pa la ma jo zhwa chung mas phug ron cig tu brdzus nas chos nyan pas/ byis pas sor rdo brgyab pas/ dgongs mo nye gnas ma la/ dge bshes ldong ston pas chos zab mo cig bshad kyin 'dug nas nyan pas/ phung byis pa kha cig gis sor rdo brgyab nas chos nyan du ma ster zer/ nyin cig 'u rang sang ni sgog pa thu ru 'dong ngo gsungs nas nye gnas mas snga dro gshegs byas pas nga 'ong gi khyed rang sngon la song zhig gsungs nas bltas pas ma byon/ nye gnas ma gar phyin sar phug ron cig byung bas/ nye gnas ma grog po gcig na de'u 'dril bas/ khyim du log tsam na ma jo'i sngun na sgog pa spar gang yang 'dug go /ma jo la sus drangs zhus pas nga rang gis btus khyod grog por de'u 'dril ba ngas bzung ste/ phug ron du sprul lo// gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'brel bsam gyis mi khyab pa gzigs te/ thab tu nub mo nas gtor/ nangs par srus su red pa byung ba dang*/ rje btsun dam pa rgya gar kyi zhal nas/ ding ri ba'i slob ma rnams la/ khyed rnams spyi la gser ra ti gcig las mi re/ bud med 'di la gser srang brgya re ba yin gsung*/ rnga cig gtad nas/ zhwa chung ma drag tu brdung gsung skad/ de grags pa chen po 'byung ba'i brda yin/ de lta bu'i rje btsun ma de la bla ma nyang sgom chen pos lo bcu gnyis bsten nas zhus/ des bla ma smon mkhar ba nyang rgyal po grags/ des kha reg gi gnyos chos kyi gzi brjid/ des bla ma ko brag pa/

des bla ma lha srung pa tro la brgyud do// yang nyang sgom la ston g.yung gis zhus/ de la zhang ston se mig pas/ de la ko brag pas so// yang bla ma smon mkhar bas/ smon mkhar jo sras sam zhwa ma'i dbon po shes rab tshul khrims su grags pa la bshad/ de la ko brag pas so// 'di dag nas brgyud pa'i yig cha phran tshigs gang zag tha dad kyis byas pa rab tu mang po snang la/ 'di dag phal che ba man ngag bzang po snang zhing*/ kha cig sbyangs pa ma byas pa'i sgom chen 'ga' zhig gis byas pa'i ci rigs pa yang snang ngo*// lam 'bras ko brag pa'i lugs ni/ bla ma dam pa ko brag pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan lam 'bras dang*/ bi bhū ti tsan+d+ra'i lugs kyi sbyor drug bsgoms pa la brten nas/ rtsa rlung gi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyud la 'khrungs pa de nyid kyis/ mkhan po smon mkhar ba la zhwa ma mo rgyud kyi man ngag brgyud pa gsum ldan gyis gdams ngag dang rje btsun zhang dgon pa la zhwa ma dkon mchog gis zhus pa/ lam 'bras zhang lugs su grags pa'i gdams ngag rnams zhus shing thugs su chud par byas/ dbang bzhi'i lam khrid dang gzhung bshad sogs man ngag yi ger ming du bkod/ lo nyi shu rtsa bzhir ra sa chu phug tu lam 'bras kho na bsgoms pas mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul mtha' yas pa thob/ rtsa rlung gi gnad gzigs pas gegs sel gzhan la ltos mi dgos par/ gegs sel thugs la rang shar du 'khrungs pa rnams yi ger bkod pa ha dmigs rgya mtsho sogs ha rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi man ngag nad gdon dbyung ba'i man ngag lam skor gyi gdams ngag bogs 'byin gnad drug gi man ngag sogs/ lam 'bras pa gong ma rnams la ma grags pa'i gegs sel gyi man ngag mang du mdzad/ de la lha sru lung pa mkha' 'gro/ rgya gar ye shes/ gnyos rdo rje seng ge gsum gyis zhus nas mang du 'phel ba yin no// gnyos rdo rje seng ge kye rdor man ngag lugs kyi dbang chu sogs lam 'bras kyi yig cha mang du byas so//

//gnyis pa zhwa ma pho rgyud du grags pa la/ lam 'bras spang rje lugs ni/ rje btsun se mkhar chung ba la ma gcig zhwa ma'i ming po rje khum bu pa zhwa ma chos kyi rgyal pos zhus/ des se sgom brag skyabs dang sras zhwa ma tsin+d+ra gnyis la bshad/ de gnyis la spang rje nyi ma grags dang rje mal jo ba gnyis kyis zhus nas/ spang rjes bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi 'grel pa/ gegs sel gyi man ngag la sogs pa mang po mdzad de dar bar byas/ de la lha zangs phug pas zhus nas gzhung bshad rgyas pa gcig mdzad/ de la sru lung pa sogs kyis zhus te dar bar byas so// lam 'bras mang lam lugs ni/ la stod lho'i pha drug pa jo ston seng ge bzang po zhes kyang bya/ byang chub bzang po dang rnal 'byor pa kye'i rdo rje ste/ mtshan gyi rnam grangs du ma dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen des mdzad pa ste/ de'ang rje btsun se mkhar chung ba/ zhwa ma chos kyi rgyal po/ zhwa ma tsan+d+ri/ bla ma zhang ban chen po/ de jo ston nyid kyis zhus nas/ thos bsam dang sgrub pa yun ring du mdzad de/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi 'grel pa rgyas pa/ lam bsdus pa'i 'grel pa/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs man ngag tshang bar mdzad cing*/ lam 'bras bsgoms pas rmi lam du mtshan ma thob nas yi ger bkod pa rmi lam lung bstan gyi man ngag 'bras bu'i man ngag yi ge gsum gyi man ngag sogs yig chung sum cu so gnyis tsam mdzad cing*/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes kyi 'grel pa dang*/ man ngag lugs kyi dbang chu bsdus pa sogs mdzad nas bshad sgrub kyis gtan la phab bo// de ltar na zhwa ma pho rgyud pa rnams la/ lam 'bras kyi yig cha bzang la mang ba cig byung snang ngo*// 'on kyang lam 'bras tso lugs/ 'brom lugs/ zhwa ma lcam sring gi lugs rnams las/ zhwa ma dang ko brag pa'i man ngag phran tshegs re tsam gyi lung ma gtogs gzhan thams cad lung tsam yang chad do//

//gsum pa man ngag mang po bsres pa'i lugs la/ lam 'bras bka' rgya mar grags pa ni/ bla ma chag na dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ grub thob dkar po grags pa/ des mdzad pa ste/ de yang chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ kun mkhyen phu hrang ba sangs rgyas grags/ de la cha gan gyi lam 'bras sa lugs zhus/ yang rje ma gcig zhwa ma/ phu dmar ba zhang ras/ mang lam zhig po/ chos sding ba nyang ras/ ma gcig nyi khri/ de la cha gan gyi zhwa lugs kyi chos skor thams cad rdzogs par zhus nas/ gar ko mang gi dgon par lo mang por sgrub pa mdzad pas/ nyams rtogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'khrungs zhing*/ slob dpon rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa sku dmar mdangs shas che ba zhig zhal gzigs zhes grags la/ phrin las dpag tu med pa byung ngo*// bla ma des phyis rin chen sgang bla brang gong mar bzhugs nas/ lam 'bras brgyud pa'i rnam thar rgyas pa/ gong 'og mang po bcos pa'i rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang*/ de dang bstun pa'i gzhung bshad rgyas pa tshig rkang sa bcad/ snang ba gsum/ gzhung ji lta ba bzhin bkri ba/ gnad drug gnad bcu gcig dbang po rab 'bring gsum rnams la khrid yig re re/ lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ mngon rtogs lag len mtshams kyis nyams myong*/ don khrid lam rim/ dbang bzhi'i brda'i don 'grol ba'i man ngag yang gsang gces pa lnga ldan/ smin grol mtshams kyi spyi chings/ zab lam kyi brjed byang nyams khrid chen mo/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ yi ge med pa'i byin rlabs sogs lam 'bras kyi man ngag pu sti chung ngu gcig mdzad/ de nyid la bla ma mnyam med grags pa rgyal mtshan la sogs pa mang pos zhus nas dar bar byas so// 'di dang cha gan gnyis kyis rdo rje'i tshig rkang rgya dpe la ma gtugs par 'gyur bcos mdzad pa sogs rang bzo che bar mdzad snang zhing*/ zhwa ma'i lugs ltar 'chad pa'i nges pa mi snang yang*/ zhwa lugs shas che bas de'i khongs su bsdus so// lam 'bras dbang rgyal lugs ni/

jo nang kun spangs chen po'i slob ma la stod dbang rgyal/ gnyos dbang rgyal du grags pa sbyor drug gi go myong bzang po yod pa'i des/ lam 'bras kyi khrid yig zab lam khyad 'phags dang*/ lam bzhi spyi'i rnam par gzhag pa rnams mdzad nas/ 'di nyid gang zag sus rnyed pa// tshe gcig sangs rgyas de yis thob// mi rtog ting 'dzin bsgom pa yis// snang ba lha ru 'char ba la// bskyed rim rtog bsgom dgos rgyu chung*// rlung sems dbu mar 'jug pa la// sngags kyi dam par bshad pa la// bsnyen sgrub 'di yis dgos rgyu chung*// rtsa mdud rlung dang me dang ni// byang chub sems kyis 'grol ba la// 'khrul 'khor 'di yis dgos rgyu chung*// thod rgal 'jug pas me 'bar phyir// gtum mo'i dmigs pa dgos rgyu chung*// byang sems me yis 'ju ba la// las kyi phyag rgyas dgos rgyu chung*// byang chub sems kyi dbang bskur la// bdag 'jug 'di yis dgos rgyu chung*// byang sems gsang gnas brtan 'geng la// bzlog 'dren 'di yis dgos rgyu chung*// dgos pa bdun dang mi dgos bdun// dgos pa bdun gyis sangs rgyas sgrub// mi dgos bdun po 'di dag ni// rmongs pa'i lto zong zog po'i chos// rang phung gzhan bslu byed par gsungs// zhes lam 'bras pa snga ma bkag nas/ rang lugs la thog mar lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi khrid byed dgos la/ de nyid sbyor drug gi sor sdud dang don gcig pas/ mun khang*/ lus gnad byed bcing sogs/ sbyor drug ltar nyams su blangs pas/ stong gzugs kyi snang ba dpag tu med pa dang*/ nyams myong shar la/ de nyid la dkyil 'khor dang lha dang sngags tshang bas gzhan zur pa nyams su len pa rnams/ rtog sgom 'ba' zhig lam du byed pa yin pas/ sangs rgyas kyi lam du mi 'gyur ro// zhes 'chad do// 'di ni ting nge 'dzin cig bsgoms pas/ de la yon tan gzhan mang po dang ldan pa'i phyir/

gzhan thabs kyi cha rnams nyams su len mi dgos zhes/ rgya nag gi mkhan po ha shang gi 'dod pa ci lta ba bzhin du snang la/ de nyid mi 'thad pa'i tshul slob dpon bdag nyid chen po ka ma la shī las bsgom rim mtha' mar legs par sun phyung ba nyid kyis shes so// lugs 'di sngar gyi lam 'bras pa su dang yang mi mthun mod/ 'on kyang brgyud pa zhwa ma la ded par snang bas/ zhwa lugs kyi khongs su bzhag go /lam 'bras jo nang lugs grags pa ni/ sbyor ba yan lag drug la sogs pa rgyud sde'i man ngag zab mo rnams la nyams myong dang mkhyen pa phyogs med du rgyas pa/ kun spangs kun tu bzang po/ dpal mi bskyod rdo rjer grags pa de nyid kyis 'jam dbyangs gzhi thog pa chen po la lam 'bras sa lugs kyi man ngag rnams zhus shing*/ bla ma lha lung ba'i dngos slob/ kha phyar ba rin chen 'od la/ zhwa lugs pho rgyud mo rgyud gnyis ka'i man ngag rnams zhus nas/ nyams len mang du mdzad pas/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi go rim sngar dang mi 'dra ba zhig bris na go bde ba zhig 'ong bar 'dug dgongs nas/ bla ma dang mkha' 'gro la gsol ba btab pas/ mnal lam du grub pa'i dbang phyug se ston kun rig gi rnam 'phrul bstan nas/ gzhung rtsoms shig pa'i gnang ba thob pa la brten nas/ zhwa lugs/ 'brom lugs/ sa lugs gsum gyi rdo rje'i tshig rkang thams cad phyogs gcig tu bris/ go rim mang po bsgyur ba'i rdo rje'i tshig rkang gcig kyang mdzad/ de'i 'grel pa dpal sa skya pa chen po dang*/ zhwa ma lcam ming dbon sras kyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa dang*/ bka' rgyud gnyis kyi 'grel pa'i bcud du bsdus nas rdo rje'i tshig rkang dkrugs pa bsdebs gab pa mngon du phyung ba'i 'grel pa'i tshig don gsal byed sgron ma dang*/ de'i bsdus don brgyud pa'i lo rgyus rnams mdzad nas/ lam 'bras rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang 'di// dkrugs bzhin bshad dam gang 'grig sdeb bshad kun// mtha' drug bshad bzhin khrid tshul yin lags mod// tshig don 'grigs bsdebs rtsa 'grel ngo mtshar he// de ltar tshig don ngo mtshar bsdebs legs 'di// snod ldan la sbyin snod min bstan mi bya// ces gdams so// de la brag kha ba grags pa seng ge

byang sems rgyal ye/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/ skal ldan sgom bzang sogs mang pos zhus nas shin tu dar bar byas so// lam 'bras lce sgom lugs ni/ rje sa skya pa chen po'i slob ma/ dpal tal phug pa la lce sgom gyis zhus so// yang rje sa chen la/ kham sgom chos kyi bla mas zhus/ de la slob dpon jo bo/ de la lce sgom rin po ches zhus nas ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pas nyams myong bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'khrungs te/ rgyas par de nyid kyi rnam thar las shes so// bla ma de la lam 'bras kyi gdams ngag rdzogs pa zhig yod par snang mod/ 'on kyang dngos su yi ger bkod pa/ lam 'bring po'i yig cha zhig mdzad/ 'di la chos lnga'i chos bzhi'i skabs su bag tsam mi 'dra ba ma gtogs gzhan rje btsun chen pos bshad pa ji lta ba bzhin snang ngo*// bla ma lce sgom gyis/ sprul sku brtson 'grus la snyan brgyud bzhis gdams nas cung zad 'phel lo// lam 'bras phag gru lugs ni/ rje sa skya pa chen po la bde gshegs phag mo gru pa/ rje kham pa rdor rgyal/ dpal mtha' rtsa ba ste mtshan gyi rnam grangs gsum dang ldan pa'i skyes bu chen po des zhus shing*/ sa skyar lo bcu gnyis bzhugs/ dka' ba dpag tu med pas bla ma mnyes par byas nas man ngag thob pa rnams yi ger bkod pa lam 'bras bshad mdzod ma zhes pa'i gzhung chen po mdzad/ kha cig dpe mdzod ma zer ba ni ma dag par snang ngo*// de'i slob ma pradz+nyā kirtis bshad mdzod ma'i steng du/ mtha' rtsa ba'i gsung sgros rnams bsnan nas/ cung zad rgyas su gtang ba zhig byas te gtan la phab bo// mdor na rtsod pa'i dus kyi rdo rje 'chang chen po rje btsun 'brog mi lots+tsha ba chen po rjes 'brang dang bcas pas man ngag 'di spel zhing dar bar byas pa yin no// //gsum pa rje btsun sa skya pa rnams kyis dar bar byas tshul la bzhi ste/ thog mar dpal sa skya pa chen pos lam 'bras gzhan dang spyi mthun du zhang dgon pa la zhus nas thugs nyams su bzhengs tshul/

de rjes su dpal bir+wa pa dang mjal te gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i gdams ngag mang po'i bka' babs tshul/ mthar dpal sa skya pa nyid kyis lam 'bras kyi don thams cad bsdus nas rje btsun chen po la gdams tshul/ de dag la brten nas da lta'i bar du 'phel ba'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ dpal sa skya pa chen po dgung lo bcu gnyis pa la 'phags pa 'jam dpal zhal gzigs nas zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams ngag gnang ste chos thams cad kyi don thugs su chud/ gzhan yang mi'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen lots+tsha chen po drug la sogs pa la gtugs pa'i rang gi yab 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ ba ri lots+tsha ba/ brang ti dar ma snying po/ nyang stod kyi khyung rin chen grags/ bla ma gnam kha'u pa/ 'khon dge chu ba chen po dgra bla 'bar/ mal gyo blo gros grags pa la sogs pa la sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i chos kyi gsan sbyong mdzad tshul rnam thar gyi yi ge rnams su gsal la/ khyad par du gsung ngag rin po che mnos tshul ni dang por rje btsun se ston kun rig dang mjal te lam 'bras kyi man ngag gi rnam grangs nyams len gyi khog sgrig tsam zhig gsan te rje btsun zhang dgon pa'i drung du gsung ngag lam 'bras lo bzhi'i bar du gsan sbyang mdzad de/ bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang nas snyan brgyud bzhis gdams te lam bsdus pa bsgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa'ang mdzad nas/ bka' rgyas kyang btab ste/ da gsung ngag rin po che 'di lo bco brgyad kyi bar du gzhan la bshad pa lta zhog ngas shes tsam yang ma zer/ de nas khyod rang gzhan la bshad dam yi ger bri'am khyod rang shes/ lar chos 'di la bdag po cig dgos bsams nas na ning nas blo ma bde ste/ da khyod la 'phrod pas blo shin tu bde gsungs/ spyir khyod kyis bsgrub par byas na lus ma spangs par grub pa thob pa rnal 'byor dbang phyug tsam cig 'ong ba yin/ bshad pa byas na 'gro ba mang po la phan thogs pa cig 'ong*/

de'ang khyod la grub pa thob pa'i slob ma gsum/ bzod pa la gnas pa'i slob ma bdun/ gzhan tshogs lam che 'bring la gnas pa mang du 'byung gsungs nas de bzhin du thugs nyams su bzhes te/ bla chen gyi sku tshe'i stod yan chad snyan brgyud 'ba' zhig yin pas yi ge med pa'i stobs kyis thugs bsnyel gyis dogs nas/ zhag re la rdo rje'i tshig rkang tshar bdun/ zla re la lam rgyas pa cha lag dang bcas pa bsam mno tshar re thugs dam du mdzad do// de ltar rje btsun se zhang gnyis la dngos su mnos pa de yan chad ni sngar gyi lam 'bras pa gzhan dang thun mong ngo*// //gnyis pa de rjes dpal bir+wa pa dang mjal te gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa'i gdams ngag mang po'i bka' babs tshul ni/ de ltar thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i skabs su dug nad drag po'i bsnyung gzhi byung nas thugs dran pa stor ba yun ring byung ste/ phyis sku khams sos pa na'ang chos thams cad brjed nas 'dug pa la chos gzhan tsho gzhung dang yi ge gzigs pas dran par byung*/ gsung ngag rin po che ni zhu sa'i bla ma ni mi bzhugs/ yi ge dang grogs shes pa ni med/ rgya gar du phyin yang zhu sa ni mi rnyed dgongs nas sa skyar sngar 'jam dbyangs zhal gzigs pa'i sgrub phug tu mtshams bcad bla ma la gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ rmi lam du bla ma zhang dgon pa ba byon sngar gyi chos thams cad gsungs/ de nas shin tu dga' zhing gsol ba cher btab pas/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa dngos su byon nas gsung ngag rin po che spyi dang bye brag gi gdams pa mang po gnang bas/ zla ba gcig gi bar du mnyan te/ spyir bla med kyi rgyud sde bdun cu don gnyis khyad par du lam sbas bshad cha lag dang bcas pa rnam 'joms bir lugs bir srung thun mong ma yin pa lam zab thun mong ma yin pa la sogs pa/ sngar zhang dgon pa ba las ma byung ba mang po gnang bas/ lam 'bras nye brgyud la rdo rje 'chang nas sa chen gyi bar bzhi las med de/

rje rtse mo'i phyag dpe las/ ye shes zla ba dri med mig la shar// sde snod gsum gyis de nyid gsal bar byas// rgya mtsho'i nang na nor bu bzhin du mdzes// blo ldan rnams kyis rtogs 'gyur gzhan gyis min// zhes bris pa'i don no// bla med kyi rgyud sde bdun cu don gnyis/ 'chad thabs kyi man ngag bzhis gsal bar byas pa'i nye brgyud kyang rdo rje 'chang nas rje btsun rtse mo'i bar lnga yin te/ rje btsun gyi ljon shing gi sa bcad kyi mjug tu/ bla med phyogs ni ris bsgyur mig bcas pa// rig byed kyis gsal lag pas me la bgo /de 'od kun gsal chu gter 'byung bar babs// blo ldan don 'di rtogs nas smra bar gyis// zhes pa'i don no// yang rtse mo yang sa chen dang bir+wa pa gnyis ka'i slob ma ste/ me dang chu bos 'byung ba rab tu bskyed// zhes bris pa'i don to// des na lam 'bras kyi gdams ngag mang po'i yig chung mang po 'byung ba phal cher kyang nye brgyud las byung ba'o// gsum pa mthar/ dpal sa skya pa nyid kyis lam 'bras kyi don thams cad bsdus nas rje btsun chen po la gdams tshul ni/ rje sa chen bde bar gshegs nas lo so drug song ba/ rje btsun chen po'i dgu pa re zhe drug bzhes pa na sa chen dngos su byon te/ sngon khyod la man ngag bstan pa'i dus kyi brjed byang 'di yin gsungs nas/ rdo dkar khru bzhi pa gcig la pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i dbus su āḥdang hūm̐/ nub byang nas g.yon skor gyi mtshams bzhir ya ra wa la gnas pa/ phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi stong par yod pa cig gtad nas/ dang po chos nyid gdan du bya// gnyis pa rlung la spar zin bya// gtum mo me drod rab tu sbar// byang chub chu rgyun rab tu gzhug /sa sogs 'byung ba dbang du 'dus// ye shes lnga ni thob par 'gyur// zhes gsungs nas lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i don thams cad bsdus nas gdams pa 'di ni mchog tu ngo mtshar ba zhig ste/

de gsal ba'i khungs 'og nas 'chad par 'gyur ro// bzhi pa de dag la brten nas da lta'i bar du 'phel ba'i tshul la dang po rje sa chen gyis bla ma'i bka' bzhin lo bco brgyad kyi bar gsang spyod kyi thugs dam mdzad pas/ sgrub pa mthar phyin nas gzhan don bya ba'i dus la babs te/ thog mar byang chub sems dpa' a seng gis lam 'bras rtsad chod nas/ gzhung bshad kyi dang po don bsdus ma/ byang chub sems dpa'i zla ba rgyal mtshan gyis zhus pa'i zla rgyal ma/ glog skya chos grags gis zhus pa'i glog skya ma/ jo gdan 'dan bus zhus pa'i 'dan bu ma/ g.ya' chung gi jo mo 'a 'u mas zhus pa'i 'a 'u ma ste/ jo mo 'di'i nyams shar ba la khyi skad 'don pa cig yod pas 'a 'u ma zer skad/ yang zhu byas kyi don du byas pas zhu byas ma/ stod sgom byang chub shes rab kyi don du byas pa cig ldan ma kyog po sgal rga thing ting ma/ yum gyi don du byas pa'i yum don ma/ thugs sras gnyen phu chung ba'i don du mdzad pas sras don ma/ yang na 'di sras rje btsun sku mched kyi don du shog dril mang po mdzad pa rnams gnyan phu chung bas phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pas na sras don ma zhes zer ba'ang yod/ de thams cad kyi rjes la gnyags zhi ra ba dbang phyug dpal gyis zhus nas mdzad pa'i gnyags ma ste/ tshogs bsgom gyi slob ma gnyags snying po rgyal mtshan sogs dang nor bar mi bya'o// de ltar rnam 'grel bcu gcig po thams cad kyang snga phyi'i gdul bya rnams kyi don du rje sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i gzhung rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi 'grel pa re yin te/ gzhung bshad zer ba thams cad rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi ṭī kar shes dgos la/ bla ma re res kyang phar phyin la ṭī ka che chung mang po byas pa bzhin te/ de dag la 'chad tshul mi 'dra ba dang*/ don ston tshul mi 'dra ba 'ga' re yod pa yin no// de ltar ma shes pa rnam 'grel bcu gcig gis ngos 'dzin la a seng ma dang don bsdus ma so sor byas pa dang*/

zla rgyal ma la yum don ma zer ba dang*/ rgyal ba 'byung gnas la dbang bzhi ngo sprod ma/ shes rab bshes gnyen la sbas pa gsal ba/ rje btsun chen po la rdo rje'i tshig rkang ma zer ba dang*/ rje btsun gyis slob ma bra ston sogs bris pa ni nor ba yin no// gzhan rje sa chen gyi slob ma dag gis byas pa zang ri phug pa/ zhu brag mar pa/ zhang se mar pa/ 'u yug gi dbu ma pa chen po/ pradz+nyā dz+wa la ma ste 'dis sam+bu ṭa'i rgyud kyi 'bru 'grel dang*/ rgyud gsum gyi dka' 'grel re dang*/ bde mchog gi bshad pa khyad par can byas 'dug ste mi nyag gi ston pa yin skad/ sa chen dang rje btsun gnyis ka'i slob ma phag mo gru pa'i bshad mdzod ma la sogs pa'i gzhung bshad bzang la mang ba yod do// gzhan yang rje sa chen gyis gdul bya smin par byas pa'i tshul la rang gi rmi ltas 'khon dge chu bas lung bstan pa dang*/ zhang dgon pa ba'i lung bstan ltar lus ma spangs par/ mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i slob ma stag byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ 'phrang 'og gi sgom pa kyi 'bar mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul thob ste lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la song ba dang*/ yang siṅga la'i gling phran na nyan thos dgra bcom pa cig gis bod na rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i sprul pa dpal sa skya pa bya ba yod pa der song zhes lung bstan pa'i dzo ki gcig ste/ mchog thob pa'i mi gsum dang*/ yang kham pa rga los rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan po tsa mi sangs rgyas grags la sbyor drug zhus nas rdo rje gdan gyi sgo khang du bsgrubs pas tshogs sbyor gyi rtogs pa skyes tsam na gzhan rkyen gyi gegs chen pos smyo rgyug byed pa cig byung*/ rgya gar du gegs sel nus pa ma rnyed pa la bod du bir+wa pa'i sprul pa sa skya pa zer ba de gegs sel mi nus pa med zer ba thos nas bla chen gyi drung du sleb/ gegs sel bas kho dga' ste glegs bam la sogs pa'i mna' spang chen po khur te rgya bod thams cad na khyod las man ngag mkhas pa yod re zer ba'i mna' cig bskyal nas song skad do// rje btsun rtse mo yang bde ba can na dngos su gshegs pa yin la/

rje btsun chen po la sogs pa bzod pa thob pa'i slob ma mang po dang*/ kham pa sbas ston te 'di rje btsun rtse mo la bdag med ma'i zin bris zhu ba po de yin la/ phag mo grub pa yang sa chen la lam 'bras zhus nas grub pa thob pa yin zer la/ gzhan yang gdul bya rab tu mang po smin grol la bkod pa yin te/ bdag nyid chen po de'i rnam par thar pa las shes shing*/ lam 'bras kyi gzhung yi ger bkod pa yang gong gi rnam 'grel bcu gcig gi nang nas tshig nyung la sdeb legs pa gzhung bshad gnyags ma tshig rkang dang bcas pa'i steng du da lta glegs bam nang du bcug pa'i yig chung 'ga' zhig dang*/ pod dmar ma'i nang du bsdus pa'i bla ma chen po'i nyams che chung la sogs pa mang po zhig yod pa rnams sag sgam gyi nang du sgo lcags brgyab ste/ phyag dpe mdzad pas de dus na sag shubs ma zhes grags pa yin skad do// gsang sngags lam gyi khog sgrig rgyud sde'i dum bu brgyad cu gya gsum pa yang mdzad de/ rnam bshad rigs par mdo sde'i dum bu bsgrigs pas lam tshang ba dang mthun la/ dbyig gnyen dang bir+wa pa gnyis ka'ang*/ thogs med kyi slob ma yin pas tshul mtshungs pa cig 'dug gsungs/ bla chen de'i sras mchog rje bsod nams rtse mo ni rgya gar grub chen mi thub zla ba'i sprul pa yin par grags shing lus ma spangs par bde ba can du gshegs pa'i tshul la sogs pa ni de'i rnam thar du gsal zhing*/ rang gi gcung rje btsun chen po lo so drug gi bar du legs par bskyangs pa'i rje btsun chen pos thog drangs gdul bya mang po smin par mdzad la/ gzhung yi ger bkod pa yang rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa'i rgyud spyi la gal che ba rgyud la 'jug pa'i sgo ste rgyud sde spyi rnam chen mo dang*/ so so la dgos pa sam+bu ṭa'i ṭī ka chen mo sogs dang*/ man ngag la gal che ba lung sbyor che chung gnyis dang*/

pod dmar ma'i nang gi gtum mo'i dmigs pa nyi shu rtsa dgu sogs dang*/ smin byed dbang chu chen mo/ sgrub thabs rgyas pa dang*/ gzhan yang glegs bam nang gi gdams ngag 'ga' zhig mdzad la/ gzhan yang las dang po rnams la gal che ba byis pa 'jug pa'i sgo/ bstan pa spyi la gal che ba chos la 'jug pa'i sgo/ gsang sngags spyi la gal che ba rgyud la 'jug pa'i sgo/ mkhas pa 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la gal che ba mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo ste sgo bzhi las/ dang po gsum bdag nyid chen po 'dis mdzad de zhib par gzhan du shes so// yang rje btsun chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhal snga nas rang gi dbon po bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta lo so lnga'i bar du bskyangs te mkhas pa dang grub pa'i sa la bzhag bod gangs can gyi bstan pa'i byi dor gyi bdag po'i bka' gnang dang*/ sku tshe'i mjug tu hor dang yon mchod du 'brel pas bod kyi bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa'i rten 'brel mdzad pas/ da lta'i bar du de bzhin du gyur pa dang*/ gzhan yang grags pa'i mtha' can bu bzhi ste/ shar na le ston dkon mchog grags/ lho na dkar shākya grags/ nub tu nub pa rig 'dzin grags/ byang na gsa' la ba dbang phyug grags dang*/ gzhan yang dga' ston rdo rje grags/ brag ston blo gros/ kar ston chos 'od/ jo sras lcags kyi rdo rje la sogs pa mkhas pa dang grub pa'i slob ma mang du 'phel la/ gzhung yi ger bkod pa yang rgyud gsum spyi la gal che ba mngon rtogs rdzogs pa ljon shing ste gsang sngags kyi lam rim chen mo dang*/ rgyud so so la gur brtag gnyis kyi 'grel pa/ man ngag la gal che ba gzhung bshad gnyags ma'i zhal shes dgu smos pa la sogs pa'i gsal byed nyer gnyis sogs glegs bam gyi dkar chag du thegs pa'i yig chung drug cu tham pa phal che ba dpe ris dang bcas pa dang dang*/ dkar chag tu smos kyang der mi bzhugs pa'i yi ge bdun gyi rtsa ltung 'khrul spangs sogs phal che ba mdzad pa dang*/

mdor na gsung ngag rin po che la yab sras gsum gyi man ngag 'thor ba thams cad bsdus/ ma dag pa thams cad bsal/ mi gsal ba thams cad gsal bar byas nas gdams ngag mi 'thor zhing gces spras bya ba'i phyir glegs bam du bsgrigs bka' rgyas btab/ dkar chag gis mtha' brten te na bza' ser pos gril nas bzhugs pas/ de dus na pod ser ma zhes grags skad/ da lta ni glegs bam zhes grags te/ 'di'i dkar chag du glegs bam chung ngu 'di na gnas pa zhes sogs glegs bam gyi ming yang yang smos pas so// rje btsun de'i thugs sras sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ni yang srid snga mar mi nas mir gyur pa'i skye ba nyi shu rtsa lngar 'jam dbyangs bla mar brten nas zhing 'dir gnas lnga rig pa thams cad mkhyen par gyur tshul nyid kyi rtogs pa brjod pa nga brgyad ma rtsa 'grel du shes la/ ma 'ongs pa na bde gshegs dri med dpal du 'tshang rgya bar lung bstan te/ 'o 'jo ba'i slob mas 'dam du 'phags pa rin po che la zhus pa na dri med dpal du bzhes nas lo 'ga' yang song bar gsung 'dug pas/ da lo mang por yang song la 'dis gdul bya smin pa'i tshul la lam 'bras kyi slob ma rgyal tsha ta 'ug pa chen po bshad pa gtso bor gyur pa'i slob ma 'u yug pa rigs pa'i seng ge la sogs pa seng ge'i mtha' can mang po dang*/ zhang mdo sde dpal dang*/ rgyal ba dpal la sogs pa'i dpal gyi mtha' can mang po dang*/ lho pa rin chen dpal/ dmar chos kyi rgyal po dang*/ yar lung pa byang chub rgyal mtshan la sogs pa rgyal mtshan gyi mtha' can mang po dang*/ chag lo/ zhang lo/ glo bo lots+tsha/ g.yag sde lots+tsha sogs lots+tsha mang po dang*/ khyad par du lam 'bras kyi sgrub pa gtso bor gyur pa/ tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal dang*/ grub thob yon tan dpal gnyis/ bstan pa spyi'i mnga' bdag 'gro mgon 'phags pa rin po che la sogs pa ste/ de dus na bod kyi chos pa thams cad kyi bla mar gyur pa zhig go

/bdag nyid chen po 'dis gzhung yi ger bkod pa la gsung rab spyi'i tshul ni/ rnam thar dang bka' 'bum gyi dkar chag du shes la/ gsung ngag gi yig chung la lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor ste 'di'i gdams ngag 'ga' zhig glegs bam gyi yig chung la rag go /rten 'brel gyi yi ge ste/ de'ang gong ma'i yi ge la rag go /phyag rgya'i dbye ba 'khor bzhi'i rgya/ lam sbas bshad/ aṣ+ṭa'i bzhi bshad/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal/ brda don gsal ba 'di shin tu gal che ste/ rje sa chen gyi lam 'bras kyi don thams cad bsdus nas gdams pa de'i gsal byed yin pa'i phyir/ yang sgrub pa lung sbyin de yang gong ma'i yi ge la ltos so// gnad du che ba drug la sogs pa mang po mdzad de zhib par gzhan du shes so// yang bstan pa'i mnga' bdag 'gro mgon 'phags pa rin po che ni mkhyen rab phul du byung zhing gzhon nu'i dus nas mkhyen pa'i yon tan mtha' yas par gyur pas 'phags pa zhes yongs su grags pa de ni/ rgyu bod hor gsum gyi bstan pa thams cad kyi mnga' bdag skye dgu thams cad kyi bde skyid kyi mgon du gyur pa des bstan pa'i bya ba rgya chen po mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ deng sang gi bar du bdag gzhan thams cad la gsal/ bu slob bskyangs pa'i tshul yang gzhung gi bshad pa gtso bor gyur pa'i slob ma dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal la sogs pa mang po dang*/ sgrub pa gtso bor gyur pa'i slob ma zhang dkon mchog dpal la sogs pa mang po ste/ chos rje sa paṇa gyi bu slob phal che ba yang bdag nyid chen po 'di'i slob ma yin la/ spyir gzhung lugs mang du mdzad cing*/ khyad par du gsung ngag rin po che la yang gzhung bshad 'phags mdzad ma zhes grags shing*/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi bsrung ba'i yi ge tshogs sbyor gyi mngon rtogs/ bdud rtsi ril bu sgrub pa'i zhal shes sogs mdzad do// yang bar skabs su sa skya pa'i bstan pa nyams dma' ba'i tshe/

grub chen brag phug pa chen po bsod nams dpal zhes bya ba byon te/ bshad sgrub kyi bu slob rab tu mang po 'phel ba'i brgyud rim ni 'og nas ston la/ de'i nang nas kyang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa chos rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa zhes bya bas/ gsung rab gang la yang mkhyen pa rgyas par mdzad de/ bod gzhan gyi bya bar ma nus pa dus 'khor 'grel chen la sogs pa mdzad cing*/ khyad par du rang gi pha chos su gyur pa kye rdor rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa la gsan sbyangs mthar phyin nas/ rgyud kyi ṭī ka che chung dang man ngag gi khrid yig dang gzhung bshad la sogs pa cha tshang ba pod nag ma zhes bya ba mdzad la/ 'di gos lcags nag gi na bza' can du mdzad pas pod nag ma zhes grag go /yang phyis kyi theg chen chos kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ rgya bod kyi gtsug rgyan dam par gyur pa des kyang*/ lam 'bras kyi gzhung bshad sogs mdzad cing bu slob mang du 'phel ba'i brgyud rim 'og nas ston to// yang chos rje sa paṇa gyi dngos slob grub tshogs dbon gsum gyis slob ma la nyan zhang gsum/ gsum ka'i bka' babs pa brag phug pa chen po yin la/ nyan chen pa dang brag phug pa gnyis ka la zhus pa chos rje bla ma dam pa dang*/ brag phug pa'i dbon po blo gros brtan pa dang*/ dpal ldan tshul khrims pa gsum/ yang dpal ldan tshul khrims pas bla ma dam pa dang*/ blo gros brtan pa gnyis la'ang zhus so// khong gi slob ma la bshad pa gtso bor gyur pa 'jam dbyangs shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan la sogs pa dang*/ sgrub pa gtso bor gyur pa grub chen bud+dha shrī ste 'di mkhan chen g.yag pa'i bla ma yang yin no// de la rje btsun dam pa don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na/ kun dga' bzang po zhes bya ba/ des dang por bdag chen kun rin dang*/ chos rje shar pa la sogs pa bsten nas gsan sbyangs rgya chen mdzad de/ dgung lo bco brgyad kyi dus su bdag chen gshegs/

nyer lnga pa'i bar du spyir mdo sngags kyi chos rgya chen po dang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa rgyud sde mang po dang*/ khyad par du kye rdo rje'i chos skor mang po dang*/ dpal ldan tshul khrims pa dang chos rje shar pa dpon slob gnyis ka la gsan kyang*/ gsung ngag rin po che ni dpal ldan tshul khrims pa la gdams ngag ci rigs pa tsam dang*/ chos rje shar pa la lam gyi khog sgrig tsam las khrid dang 'brel pa gsan pa ma byung*/ de rjes sa bzang 'phags pa'i spyan sngar yang mdo sngags kyi chos rgya chen po dang*/ chos rje g.yag pa la phar tshad la sogs pa'i sde snod mang po dang*/ zhwa lu pa'i chos rgyud 'dzin pa mkhan chen bkra rin pa la yo ga la sogs pa'i chos mang po dang*/ bla ma dam pa'i dngos slob lots+tsha ba skyabs mchog la yang mdo rgyud kyi chos mang du gsan kyang*/ gsung ngag rin po che rdzogs par ma byung bas thugs the tshom du gyur pa la lung bstan gyi mnal lam khyad par can dang*/ sngar gyi gsan dgongs khyad par can la brten nas grub chen bud+dha shrī'i spyan sngar byon te/ nyams khrid rdzogs pa dang gdams ngag zab mo gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa mang po gnang ste snyan brgyud bzhis gdams so// gzhan yang dus 'khor sbyor ba yan lag drug la ra 'bro sa gsum gyi lugs so so ba dang*/ de dag dang tshul cung zad mi 'dra ba dang*/ u rgyan bsnyen sgrub dang*/ sron lugs su grags pa la sogs pa mang po gnang ste/ 'phral phug gi lung bstan du ma dang bcas pas gdams so// gzhan yang sa skya pa las 'phel ba ni/ sa chen gyi dngos slob phag mo gru pa'i gzhung bshad kyi zin bris chen po mtha' rtsa ba seng ge dh+wa dzas byas pa zer ba dang*/ phag gru pa rang gis kyang gsang sngags lam rim du lam 'bras kyi brda chad mang po bris pa dang*/ dgas rgyud pa phyi ma rnams kyis nā ro chos drug dang lam 'bras bsres pa'i nyams len byas pa la/

sdom gsum rab dbyer/ nā ro chos drug ces bya'i khrid// mi la yan chad de las med// chos drug bor nas lam 'bras sogs// gzhan gyi gdams ngag bsgom bzhin du// zhes sogs gsungs pa yin no// yang rje btsun chen po dang*/ chos rje sa paṇa gnyis ka'i dngos slob shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas kyis gzhung bshad chen po mdzad de/ mjug cung ma rdzogs pa chos rje pa dang shes rab 'byung gnas gnyis ka'i slob ma shar pa rdo rje 'od zer gyis byas pa yod do// yang nags phug pa shes rab 'od zer zhes bya ba 'jam dpal dngos su zhal gzigs pa des/ dang po chos rje sa paṇa la dgag pa byas pas 'jam dbyangs ma mnyes pa byung bas/ chos rje khu dbon gnyis ka la gtugs shing lam 'bras kyang zhus te/ lam 'bras brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang*/ chos rje khu dbon gyi bstod pa khyad par can re re yang byas te/ nags phug pa las 'phel ba yang yod do// yang 'phags pa rin po che'i gdan sa shar pa 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan zhes bya bas hor bod thams cad kyi bstan pa'i bdag po byas pa des/ 'phags pa dang nag phug pa gnyis ka la zhus so// yang 'jam dbyangs chen po dang*/ nags phug pa'i slob ma byang pa sbyar ba rin chen 'od zer gnyis la jo nang gi kun spangs thugs rje brtson 'grus kyis zhus te/ gzhung bshad chen po byas tshul gong du bris pa ltar ro// 'dis sbyor drug gi thog mtha' bar dge'i khrid yig rnams byas/ jo nang gi dgon pa btab pa yin pas jo nang yang sa skya'i dgon lag ste/ 'di'i dus na jo nang pa zhes zur pa med/ khong gi dngos slob kun mkhyen dol bu pas byas pa'o// yang kun spangs kyi slob ma la stod dbang rgyal gyis gzhung bshad byas pa'i tshul yang sngar bzhin no// yang chos rje pa'i slob ma tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal las gnyags snying po rgyal mtshan gyis zhus/ de las bar ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang*/

rgya rgan thugs rje bsod nams gnyis kyis zhus te/ snga mas bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar zhib mo rdo rje zer ba dang*/ gzhung bshad dmar ma'i zin bris chen mo byas so// phyi mas kyang gzhung bshad chen mo mdzad/ yang rje btsun gyi slob ma brag ston gyis byas pa'i gzhung bshad khyad par can dang*/ chos rje pa'i slob ma gcig gis byas pa'i gzhung bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer bya ba yod do// yang chos rje pa'i slob ma dmar chos kyi rgyal pos chos rje'i gsung bzhin du yig chung 'ga' zhig dang*/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar dang gzhung bshad dmar ma zhes yongs su grags pa de mdzad do// yang dmar gyi slob ma sgang ston shes rab 'bum dang*/ tshogs sgom gyi slob ma nyan chen bsod nams brtan gnyis la shangs kyi dkar po brag pa rin chen seng ges zhus so// 'di lo brgya dang lnga thub pa'i grub chen zhig yin te/ khong rang gi mi rgyud kyi dge bshes da lta'i bar du yod cing*/ khong la sa skya'i mkhan chen dbang phyug dpal dang dpal ldan tshul khrims gnyis kyis lam 'bras zhus so// yang chos rje pa'i slob ma grub thob yon tan dpal dang tshogs sgom gnyis la/ la ru ba bsod nams seng ge dang*/ nyan chen pa bsod nams brtan gyis zhus/ de gnyis ka las rgyang gi don mo ri pa grags pa dpal gyis zhus/ de las spang sgang ba grags pa dpal te/ kun mkhyen gangs khrod par grags pa des zhus/ de las sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyis zhus/ de rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa la dgongs nas theg chen chos kyi rgyal pos lam 'bras tshang mar zhus kyang*/ khong la chags med rnams med pas/ sa skya'i zur khang bu ston dbang phyug rgyal po la theg chen pas zhus so// yang zhang dkon mchog dpal gyis grub thob yon tan dpal gyi slob mar gnyis pa rin chen rgyal mtshan la lam 'bras tshang mar zhus kyang*/ khungs btsun pa mi rgyud dang chos rgyud gnyis ldan la bsams nas 'phags pa rin po che smar khams dpal 'bar du bzhugs pa'i drung du phyin/

gar byon gyi chag phyir lam 'bras zhu shing bsgoms pas/ 'phags pa'i brtag gnyis mdzo 'gro ma de dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal la yod lam 'bras mdzo 'gro ma de zhang dkon mchog dpal la yod ces grags so// de lta bu'i zhang dkon mchog dpal la brag phug pa chen po bsod nams dpal gyis zhus/ 'di nyid bla brang rin chen sgang pa rang gi mi yin pa'i 'brel dang gang zag bzang ba la dgongs nas chos rje bla ma dam pas zhus pa la/ gangs khrod pa dpon slob na re/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi gdams ngag thams cad chos rje sa paṇa la yod/ de'i gdams ngag thams cad tshogs grub gnyis la'ang yod/ de nyid kyi gdams ngag thams cad lar nyan gnyis la yod/ de gnyis kyi gdams ngag thams cad nged dpon slob gnyis la yod pa yin te/ khong rang rin chen sgang ba'i mi yin pas brag phug pa la zhu bar 'dug go /ces yid ma rangs par byung skad/ de lta bu'i grub thob brag phug pa chen po de ni sku tshe sgrub pa la skyel/ thugs dam gyi skabs su bstan pa'i bya ba dang 'gro phan mdzad/ khyad par du zab mo 'khor lo bde mchog gi chos skor dang*/ kye rdor rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa thams cad kyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi sgo nas/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa rming nas bslangs te/ deng gi bar du yang brag phug pa'i phyag len la yod med ces dpang por byed pa yin no// de dus nas bu dol gnyis grags che bas/ rgyud sde'i dgongs don ma nges par sngar gyi bshad srol bzang po tsho sun 'byin pa la dga' ba dang*/ lta ba gzhan stong kho na mchog go zhes pa'i 'ud grags kyi rjes su 'brang ba mang ste/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa nyams dma' ba la grub chen 'dis/ bla 'khor ba nam mkha' grub la sogs pa/ mdo sngags kyi gnad la mkhas pa'i bu slob mang po spel bas bstan pa'i byi dor kyang 'bad med du byung ba yin no// yang 'phags pa'i slob ma sru lung kun smon dang*/

tshogs sgom gyi slob ma nyan chen pa gnyis ka las zhus pa bla ma dpal ldan seng ges nyan chen pa'i slob ma 'jam skya nam mkha' rdo rje la yang zhus te/ dpal ldan seng ge la bla ma dam pas zhus shing khong zhwa lu bu ston gyi sa lugs kyi chos skor mang po zhus pa'i bla ma yang yin no// spru lung pas kyang gzhung bshad legs po dang gnyags ma la phan pa'i zin bris dang*/ lam bsdus pa'i bshad pa/ a seng ma'i ṭī ka rnams mdzad do// yang brag phug pa la slob ma mi che ba bla ma dam pa sku mched/ la stod kyi chos rje dkon mchog rgyal mtshan pa dang*/ mdo khams dpal 'bar gyi the mchu ba blo gros dkar po sogs byon pa las/ bu ston la theg chen pa dang*/ khams kyi 'be sher rin gyis zhus/ dkon mchog rgyal mtshan pa las zur khang bu ston dang g.yag sde pa nam mkha' bsod nams kyis zhus/ g.yag sde pa las brtse chen chos rjes zhus/ yang theg chen pas bla ma dam pa'i lam 'bras pod nag ma'i lung*/ jo nang chos rje las byang seng gis zhus/ yang go 'gyo ye shes dpal gyis dpal 'bar du blo gros dkar po la lam 'bras zhus nas shin tu dad de/ dbus gtsang du yang*/ grub chen brag phug pa la snang gsum gyi khrid yan chad thob/ lhag ma blo gros brtan pa'i drung du zhus shing dge sbyor gyi 'tsho ba rnyed sla bas/ mon phag ri khar phyin nas gzhung bshad sogs kyi dpe 'dzin dang*/ dge sbyor la lo 'ga' zhig bzhugs/ tshur 'ong zhwa lur yang bzhugs nas sa skyar phyin pas mkhan chen g.yag pa dang blo bzang dkar mo sogs mang pos lam 'bras zhus/ blo bzang 'di mcham la khar skyes pa yar sa skyar slebs nas gling tshang du zhugs pa cig yin te/ ye shes dpal dang blo bzang dpon slob 'di gnyis gdams ngag dang chos rgyud la shin tu gus pa thugs dam bzang ba yin 'dug pas/ shar btsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa la sogs pas kyang gtsigs su byed pa cig byung 'dug la/

de dus na sa skya pa'i sgrub rgyud kyi bstan pa nyams dma'/ gzhan du lam 'bras ston mkhan mkhas pa med 'dug pas/ khong gnyis la lam 'bras kyi gdul bya mang po byung 'dug kyang*/ bshad sgrub kyi phyag len bzang po med pa'i lo rgyus 'dug pa dang*/ de dag nas brgyud pa yin zer ba 'ga' re da lta grags pa rnams la yang lam 'bras kyi phyogs 'gros snang la ma nges pa rang du grag go /yang chos rje sa chen gyi dngos slob lam 'bras dkar chag byed mi rje btsun lung phu ba bsod nams rin chen las mkhas grub gzhon nu grub dang*/ shab bkras lung pa gnyis kyis zhus te/ dang pos sdom gsum gyi bshad pa chen mo rtsa 'grel gnyis byas te/ ne gu pa'i grub thob tu grag go /phyi ma la re mda'i zhang byang shes zhus/ de las bla ma dam pas zhus/ de las lots+tsha ba byang rtses zhus nas bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang*/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar dang*/ rdo rje tshig rkang la mchan 'debs pa byas so// yang byang rtse'i slob ma nam mkha' 'od zer zhes pas lam 'bras glegs bam gyi yig chung rnams so sor chung ngur btang ba'i glegs bam byas pa'ang yod la/ yang dkar shākya grags kyis spyir rgyud gsum sogs gang la yang yi ge byas shing khyad par du lam 'bras kyi gzhung bshad/ yig chung mtha' dag dang bcas pa legs po rang yod do// yang sa chen gyi slob ma zhu brag dmar pa'i glegs bam la gzhung bshad gnyags ma'i steng du yig chung thams cad sa lugs las nyung ngur btang ba'i glegs bam byas pa la/ thog mar rdo rje tshig rkang dang gnyags ma yod pa mthong nas/ sa lugs kyi glegs bam rang yin snyam pa srid de/ de 'dra 'ga' re 'dug pas ma nor dgos so// yang chos rje sa paṇa gyi slob ma pu rang pa sangs rgyas grags dang 'phags pa rin po che dang shar pa 'jam dbyangs chen po'i slob ma cha gan zhes bya bas gzhung bshad chen mo bka' rgya ma sogs byas tshul sngar bzhin te/
