cha gan la mnyam med grags rgyal gyis zhus/ de las si tu byang rgyal gyis zhus/ des chos rje bla ma dam pa bla mchod du khur/ dbus kyi snye thang chos rdzong la sogs pa brtsigs nas phul/ zhabs tog cher byas so// bla brang rin chen sgang pa'i brgyud pa la gus par dgos tshul gyi zhal chems bzhugs so// khong sa skya pa'i bu slob yin pa 'on kyang rang srid zur du bskyangs/ rdzong chen po bcu gsum brtsigs nas da lta phag mo gru pa'i sde pa zhes grags par byas so// yang dpal na len+d+ra'i rong ston chos kyi rjes/ theg chen pa la lam 'bras snang ba gsum gyi khrid yan chad gsan te/ phyis la stod lho'i bla ma rdo rje mgon zer ba la tshad mar gsan nas thugs dam du mdzad cing*/ phyis dpal na len+d+ra'i dgon pa 'debs pa'i 'brug lo la 'phan yul nyan po'i dgon par lam 'bras tshar gcig gsungs pa bdag gis kyang thos so// yang theg chen chos kyi rgyal po'i dngos slob chen po glang thang gi spyan snga rin po che kun dga' rgyal mtshan zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa des ni sgrub pa thugs dam gyi rim pa thams cad chos kyi rgyal po de nyid kyi ji lta ba bzhin phyag len la thebs par mdzad nas/ chos dang zang zing gi sgo nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po dang bstan pa la phan pa rgya cher mdzad pa yin no// de nas theg chen chos kyi rgyal po'i phyag len gyi tshul de 'dra ba zhig yod 'dug pa la/ deng sang yul 'ga' zhig tu theg chen pa nas brgyud pa yin zer ba dang*/ blo bzang dkar mo nas brgyud pa yin zer ba 'ga' re la'ang*/ 'khor bsdu ba la dmigs nas khrid yig gam zin bris tsam klog pa'i chos kyi gzugs brnyan tsam las mi 'dug ste/ rgyu dbang gar bskur gyi nges pa tsam yang med pa dang*/ lam dus kyi dbang mi bskur bar slob ma dang mnyam 'don byed pa'i rdzun rigs sna tshogs pas rang gzhan slu bar byed pa dag ni sa skya pa'i gser chos zab mo rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa la mkhas pa zhes zer ba'i don thams cad brlag par ma byed cig

ces bdag gis gsol ba 'debs shing chos 'di'i srung ma dag gis kyang dpang por mdzod cig des na nged kyi brgyud pa 'di la grub chen dpal ldan tshul khrims zhes bya bas sngar smos pa nas dang por brag phug pa dang*/ blo gros brtan pa sogs la gsan sbyangs mthar phyin par byas te/ chos rje bla ma dam pa sku na gzhon nur gyur pa'i dus dpal ldan sa skyar khrid 'dzugs pa'i khrid gnyer du brdzangs nas/ bla ma dam pa la mnga' ba'i yon tan thams cad kyang thugs su chud par mdzad pa'i skyes bu de las chos rje shar ba dang grub chen bud+dha shrī la sogs pas zhus shing de dag thams cad kyi bstan pa'i mdzod 'dzin pa rje btsun kun dga'i mtshan can des ni mdo sngags gang la yang phyi rabs pa dag rang gi blo gros kho nas 'jug pa dag gzigs pas rkyen byas te/ spyir gzhung lugs dang grub mtha' gang la yang khung gtugs pa'i gzhung gang yin pa dang rang rang gi brgyud pa gang yin pa dang*/ bshad srol so so'i man ngag gang yin phug legs par bcad nas/ spyis phyin par thugs su chud pas/ phyi rabs pa dag rang gi 'dod pa kho na lhur blangs te bris shing phal cher phod tshod du 'dug par dgongs nas/ spyir gsung rab thams cad kyi so so'i lam gyi bgrod tshul gdams ngag gi gnad lag len gyi rim pa phra mo tshun chod phan tshun ma 'dres pa spyi sgos kyi bstan pa'i 'dzin skyong gang la yang 'gran pa'i zla dang bral bar bzhugs shing*/ khyad par du dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa rin po che rang gzhan gyis sgro 'dogs dang skur 'debs kyi 'dam du bying ste mi gsal ba'i skabs su/ bdag nyid chen po 'dis rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa'i lung rigs kyi char chen phab nas/ log rtog gi dri ma thams cad 'khrud pa'i byi dor byas te/ dri ma med pa'i bstan pa rin po che bshad sgrub kyi rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor mchod pas dgos 'dod phyogs mtha' dag tu stsol pa'i phrin las bzang po can no// bye brag tu gsung ngag lam 'bras 'di la bar skabs su lam 'bras pa ye shes dpal dpon slob la sogs pas rje btsun gong ma'i gzhung khungs ma la gtugs/

rgyud steng 'og gi lam khog bsgrig ma nges par khrid ston tshul la sogs pa 'o le ba las ma byung 'dug pa gzigs pas rkyen byas te/ rgyud gsum man ngag gi khungs legs par gtugs pas rgyud kyi skal dman rim 'jug tu/ dang po gso sbyong sbyin pa nas// de'i rjes su dbu ma bstan pa sogs dang*/ de rjes kyai'i rdo rje ston// zhes sogs kyi lam khog bsgrig ljon shing du/ lam thun mong ba la bslab zin nas/ rgyu dbang dang sngags lam ston pa gsal bar gsungs shing*/ man ngag gi rdo rje'i tshig rkang du/ snang gsum gyi rjes la/ gdan sogs gsum pa bzhis rgyu'i dbang*/ zhes sogs rgyud dang man ngag mthun par byung bas/ khrid ston dus phar phyin theg pa'i nyams len thams cad snang ba gsum du 'dus pas snang gsum gyi khrid sngags lam thams cad rgyud gsum du 'dus pas rgyud gsum gyis dkri ba zhes dang*/ snang gsum gyi khrid tshar rjes/ rgyu dbang bskur ba sogs bya dgos te/ rje sa chen gyis/ snang ba gsum gyi lam gyi gzhi bcas te// nyams len ma lus rgyud gsum dag gis shes// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ rje btsun gyi khrid yig tshigs bcad mar/ snang gsum gyi khrid gsungs tshar ba'i rjes su/ pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung lugs mdor bsdus na// snying po don gyi man ngag 'di dag yin// zhes dang*/ gzhung ji lta ba bzhin dkri ba'i khrid yig tu/ sngags kyi gzhung thams cad rgyud gsum du 'du bas/ rgyud gsum du dkri ba zhes dang*/ khrid yig de gnyis kar snang gsum gyi rjes la rgyu dbang bskur ba sogs bshad pas so// de bzhin du bsam gtan gyi yan lag rnams kyang thog mar byed pa ma yin te/ rdzogs rim zab mo kun gyi sngon 'gro ni// sbyang ba gsum yin de nas rlung la bslab// ces gsungs pa ltar/ de dag sngags lam dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi sngon 'gro yin pas so// gal te rgyu dbang snang gsum gyi rjes rang la byed dgos na gzhung bshad rnams su/

nyams snang gi rten rnal 'byor pa de/ thos bsam dang*/ bslab pa dang*/ dbang gi rgyud sbyangs pa gcig la bshad pa de/ ji ltar yin snyam na/ chos rje sa paṇa gyis/ khrid ma rdzogs par gzhung mi bshad/ ces sogs gsungs pa'i tshad ma bzhi'i go rim mi shes pa dag la de'i the tshom skye ba bden na'ang*/ de'i don ni da lta bla ma gcig gis slob ma la dang por dus 'khor gyi zab lam gyi khrid bstan/ de'i rjes su dus 'khor gyi rgyud gzhung du lam zab mang po gsungs pa slob mas gzhung gcig tu yi ger bkod pa ltar/ bdag med mas bir+wa pa la/ dang por kyai rdor gyi smin grol gyi lam zab mo bstan nas/ grub pa'i sa la bzhag de rjes gdul bya gang la ci 'tshams kyi lam rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ zab 'bring tha gsum la sogs pa rgyud don zab mo rdzogs par gsungs pa rnams/ bi rū pa rang gi gzhung rdo rje'i tshig rkang du bkod pa yin gyi/ tshig rkang nang gi gdam ngag thams cad kyis/ bir+wa pa rang nyid dkris pa ga la yin te/ gtum mo'i dmigs pa tshang ba'i thog gi ched brjod du/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug dmigs pa 'di kho nas grol ba yin no zhes 'byung ba bzhin no// de bzhin du bir+wa pa'i dngos slob nag po pa yang*/ rgyud ltar na skal dman rim 'jug /tshig rkang ltar na/ lus so sor brtag pa'i 'gog pa'i khrid bstan nas grub pa'i sa la bkod/ de rjes rdo rje'i tshig rkang tshang bar gsungs pa yin gyi/ tshig rkang nas bshad pa'i lam thams cad kyis nag po pa dkris pa ma yin te/ lam zab 'bring tha gsum gyi lam zab bla ma dang*/ tha ma'i lus so sor brtag pa'i 'gog pa'i khrid tshul gnyis shin tu 'gal bas so// des na da lta tshad ma bzhi ldan gyi khrid ston pa'i tshul ni/ skal dman rim 'jug kho na gtso bas dang por gzhung ji lta ba bzhin khrid/ de rjes khrid tshul de tshig rkang gi don no zhes ston pa dang*/ gdams ngag gi rnam grangs gzhan yang 'di ltar yod do zhes bstan pa'i ched du gzhung bshad/

de rjes su tshig rkang gi gzhung ji lta ba bzhin khrid tshul de rgyud kyi skal dman rim 'jug gi don yin zhing*/ tshig rkang gi gdams ngag gzhan thams cad kyang rgyud don yin no zhes bstan pa'i phyir du/ gdams ngag lung thams cad dang sbyar ba ston pas/ gzhung bshad dus ngo sprod kyi tshul du 'chad pa yin pas/ chos rje sa paṇa gyi gsung sgros la/ spyir chos kyi 'doms che ba de go na gzhan sla bas 'dir yang*/ bla ma bzhi'i skabs de legs par go na/ gzhung 'og ma bklag pas chog go zhes 'byung ba ltar/ gzhung bshad kyi thog ma'i mchod brjod bshad par dam bcas pas/ lam thams cad mdor bstan/ snang gsum gyis lam thams cad rgyas par bshad/ rgyud gsum dang gzhung lhag mas shin tu rgyas par bshad pa'i lugs yin gyi/ khrid dmigs ji lta ba bzhin du med la/ gzhan du na/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs pad btud de/ zhes pa'i mchod brjod nas lam 'bras thams cad rdzogs nas snang gsum man chad mi dgos par 'gyur ro// des na gzhung bshad du nyams snang gi rgyu la/ khams 'dus pa gsum dang*/ nyams snang la nyams bco lnga dang*/ dbang snang la sngags lam la brten nas bde bar gshegs tshul la sogs bshad pa yin no// des na tshul 'di la blo legs par byas nas smra bar rigs so// gzhan yang bir+wa pa'i dngos slob gnyis la bshad srol mi 'dra ba 'ong ba'i rgyu mtshan yang snang ste/ rje bla mas mi gsungs pas ma bris so// deng sang ni khrid ma rdzogs pa nas lam 'bras kyi 'dod pa rdzogs par/ khrid ston mkhan gyi bla ma dang*/ slob ma bzhed pa mthun par 'dug na'ang*/ lam 'bras nyams su len 'dod yin na khrid tshar nas gzhung bshad cis kyang nyan dgos te/ khrid yig ni dmigs pa'i rnam grangs ston pa tsam yin pas dmigs pa'i mtha' chad/ nyams skyes pa'i bogs 'don gegs sel dang bcas pa gzhung bshad la rag las pas so// der ma zad gegs sel la pod dmar ma'i nang gi zhal shes kyi yi ge rnams gal che zhing*/

sngags kyi lta ba lhan skyes chos gsum gcig skyes grub bzhin dang*/ phyi bskyed rim gyi dmigs pa so gnyis mtsho skyes bzhin dang*/ bogs 'byin brgyad bsam mi khyab bzhin gsungs pas lam skor gzhan brgyad kyang mnyan nas shes pa gal che'o// 'o na lam bskor gzhan rnams la dbang dang byin rlabs re byed nas nyams su len nam/ dpe lung tsam gyis chog ce na/ rje 'brog mis bla ma so so la zhus pa yan chad/ brgyud pa so so la rang rang gi rgyud la brten pa'i dbang legs par bskur nas khrid ston dgos la/ 'brog mis kyang lam 'bras ma gnang bar/ lam skor gzhan gnang ba la so so'i dbang mdzad nas gnang ba yin kyang*/ lam 'bras pas zhar chos su byed pa'i tshul ni/ lhan cig skyes grub la ḍoṃ bi pa'i bsrung ba dang*/ yi ge med pa la byin rlabs chung ngu gcig dang*/ bsam mi khyab la bdag med ma'i lus dkyil gyi dbang chog dang 'dra ba'i byin rlabs gcig yod/ gzhan rnams lung la brten nas gdams ngag tshul mthun pas phan 'dogs pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig tshul mi mthun yang nges shes bskyed pa yin no// des na nged kyi bla ma chos kyi rje des ni rgyu mtshan de dag thugs kyi yul du nye bar bzung nas/ gsung ngag lam 'bras kyi bstan pa mi gsal ba gsal bar byas/ ma tshang ba kha bskangs/ 'thor ba bsdus glegs bam gyi dkar chag tu thebs pa'i gzhung thams cad nyams len du bsgrigs pa gsang ba'i sgo 'byed mdzad pa dang*/ dkar chag tu man ngag phra mo gzhan gyi dkar chag kyang brjod par ga la nus pas 'dir ma bris so// zhes gsungs pa'i man ngag phra mo thams cad kyang rtsad bcad ste phyogs gcig tu bsdus/ mi 'thor bar bya ba'i phyir dkar chag dang bcas te glegs bam chung ngur mdzad pa pod dmar ma ste/ 'di yang phyag dpe na bza' dmar pos gril bar mdzad pas pod dmar ma zhes grags so// de ltar glegs bam che chung gnyis su bzhugs pa'i yi ge thams cad kyang 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin tshad ma bzhi'i srang du bcug nas nyams len la lhag chad med pa gcig ste/

dmar gyi slob ma gcig gis byas pa'i zin bris la yi ge thams cad kyang tshad ma bzhir bsdus par byas 'dug pa gzigs pa yin gsungs so// gzhan yang chos rje rin po che 'di la mnga' ba'i lam 'bras 'di ni/ gdams ngag rtsad gcod lugs la gang yang lhag ma ma lus pa/ lam khog bsgrig lugs la go rim ma 'chol zhing*/ mgo mjug tshang ba nyams len gyi gnad nas 'dzin lugs kyang gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa zhig ste/ chos rje nyid kyi gsung las/ sgrub thabs 'di ni rje btsun sa skya pa// brgyud par bcas pa'i dgongs pa yin mod kyi// deng sang lam 'bras pa zhes yongs grags pa'i// bshes gnyen kun gyi lta ba'i spyod yul min// zhes dang*/ lam 'bras snying po bsdus pa'i don// gnyis las gsum byung gdams ngag yin// kun dang thun mong ma yin pa// man ngag shes pa bla ma'i drin// zhes pa ltar/ bla ma mnyes pa'i zhal la rag go /zhes gsungs pa bzhin te/ bdag cag rnams la ltos na/ gsum las bzhi 'byung gdams ngag yin// kun dang thun mong ma yin pa// man ngag shes pa chos rje'i drin// yang rje 'dis spyir gdul bya smin pa'i tshul la/ rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs sogs 'dul ba 'dzin pa 'bum phrag gi mkhan po/ theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed lugs gnyis 'bog pa sogs sde snod 'dzin pa 'bum phrag gi bshes gnyen/ sngags kyi smin grol gyi lam dang*/ rgyab rten gyi rgyud ston pa sogs rgyud sde 'dzin pa 'bum phrag zhig gi bla ma mdzad pa zhig go /yang rje 'di nyid kyis rgyal tshab chos rje mus pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan pa ni/ sku tshe snga ma nas byang chub sems dpa' gyur ba zhig ste/ sku tshe 'dir yang gzhon nu nas byang chub kyi thugs dang ldan pa dam pa'i chos kyi gsan sbyangs gang mdzad kyang sgrub pa nyams len dang sems can gyi don la gzhol ba 'ba' zhig ste/ rje 'di'i drung du gsung ngag rin po che gsan pa'i tshe na bstan pa la phan pa'i mtshan ltas bzang po byung nas man ngag bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang ste/

rje de nyid zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i tshe na'ang rang gi rgyal tshab tu bka' bsgo mdzad de/ sngar gyi mtshan ltas dang bka' bsgos pa bzhin bshad sgrub kyi rgyal mtshan mngon par mtho ba/ bde dgyes gsang gsum sogs gang la yang rang gzhan gyi srol lugs kyi gnad zab mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag la rang dbang thob pa'i tshul gyis legs par mkhyen nas 'chad pa bstan pa'i rtsa ba 'dzin lugs gzhan dang 'gran zla med pa'i mkhas grub chen po zhig ste/ da lta'i skye bo phal mo che 'chad pa po'i kha la blta bas tshim pa rnams kyis ni de dag gi gnas tshul shes par dka'o// chos rje 'di nyid kyis kyang khrid kyi zin ris dang*/ rje'i rnam thar la sogs mang du mdzad do// yang mkhas grub chos rje gzhon nu la sogs pa/ rje'i bu slob rab tu mang po byon pa sogs kyang*/ rje'i rnam thar sogs su shes par bya'o// de yan chad ni thog mar gdams ngag byung ba'i tshul lo// //spyi don gnyis pa byung ba'i chos la bshad bsgrub bya tshul la gsum ste/ gtan la dbab par bya ba'i gzhung ngos gzung ba/ de bshad thabs kyi man ngag man ngag de bzhin du nyams su len pa'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ sngar smos pa'i glegs bam dang pod dmar ma'i nang du bzhugs pa'i yi ge thams cad yin te/ lam 'bras la dgos pa'i gzhung thams cad phyogs gcig tu bri na dus 'khor 'grel pa tsam zhig 'byung gsungs so// gnyis pa de 'chad thabs kyi gdams ngag ni/ tshad ma bzhi'i srang du bcug pa ste/ bla ma tshad ma la sogs pa sam+bu ṭi'i rgyud las gsungs so// gsum pa gdams ngag de bzhin du nyams su len pa la/ dang por bla ma tshad mar bya ba la gang dgos pa thams cad stob cing mos gus bya/ de rjes nyams myong tshad ma la dgos pa nyams myong ma skyes pa skye ba'i thabs/ skyes pa bogs 'byin gyi skor/ gegs sel gyi skor la sogs pa rnams so// de rjes bstan bcos tshad ma la dgos pa gzhung bshad dang*/

de la phan pa'i yi ge che chung thams cad skabs so sor sbyar ro// bla ma don ri brag chen pa'i rnam thar na gzhung bshad bco brgyad kyi lung zhus zer ba yod 'dug kyang*/ brgyud pa 'di la don bsdus ma dang*/ sras don ma dang*/ gnyags ma ste rnam 'grel bcu gcig gi thog ma bar ma tha ma gsum/ dmar ma dang pod nag ma'i gzhung bshad de/ lnga'i bshad lung bzhugs so// de yang gzhung 'chad tshul la gal che ba/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang du/ lam rgyas pa la snang gsum dang*/ rgyud gsum sogs chos bco brgyad/ lam 'bring po la chos lnga/ bsdus pa la chos gsum/ gzhan yang lam zab 'bring tha gsum ste/ lam la tshul drug 'bras bu lan bzhir bshad pa'i 'bras bu che ba gsum ldan te/ lam 'bras tshul dgu ru gnas pa la/ khrid tshul so sor byed na/ rgyas bsdus sna tshogs yod kyang*/ lam rgyas pa'i chos la bco brgyad thams cad rgyud gsum du bsdus nas nyams su len dgos te/ gzhung bshad rnams su snang gsum sogs kyi snga phyi gnyis 'brel rtsis pa'i don nges pa gal che'o// 'on kyang gong bzhin mdo sngags kyi lam nyams len tshul gnyis su bsdus nas/ lam yongs rdzogs gcig tu bsgrig na snang gsum dang rgyud gsum du 'dus pas de gnyis thog ma'i gzhir bkod do// zhes go dgos te/ don bsdus mas go bar nus la// rje btsun gyi khrid yig tshigs bcad lhug gnyis kyis shes so// de yang dper na/ phar phyin la mngon rtogs rgyan rtsa 'grel du skabs gong 'og mang por lam tshang ba re bshad kyang*/ skabs thams cad dril nas gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi nyams len tshang bar byed pa bzhin no// khrid tshul gzhan thams cad kyang rgyud gsum gyi nang du 'dus te/ gzhi'i chos gang yin dang*/ lam gyi chos gang yin dang*/ 'bras bu'i chos gang yin pa rnams rgyu rgyud/ thabs rgyud/ 'bras rgyud gsum po so sor ma 'dus pa med cing*/ rgyud don thams cad rgyud gsum du bsdus nas nyams len du bsgrig pa mngon rtogs ljon shing bzhin no// lam 'bras kyi nyams len thams cad rgyud gsum du 'du ba gzhung bshad a seng ma dpang por yod do// de rjes lung tshad ma ston te lung sbyor rnams so// mdor na 'chad thabs gsang ba'i sgo 'byed du gsungs pa'i khog sgrig gi steng du pod dmar ma'i yig chung rnams kyang tshad ma bzhi'i skabs so sor sbyor ba shes dgos so// khog sgrig gi gzhi'am gzhungs shing gal che ba rje btsun gyi khrid yig gnyis so// spyi don gsum pa sgrub pa mthar phyin pas gzhan don bya tshul la/

skal dman la gsang zhing skal ldan la spel bar gdams pa ste/ khrid kyi chos thams cad tshar ba'i rjes su gsang ba bcus rgyas gdab pa mdzad de pod dmar du yod pa de'o// gdams ngag tshar ba'i rjes su sgrub pa lung sbyin pa'i gdams pa slob ma la gcig brgyud du ster te/ rten 'brel gyi mkhyen pa mnga' ba'i bla ma yin na/ zhang dgon pa bas sa chen la lung bstan pa bzhin bya/ de ltar min kyang chos la gces spras su sgrub pa la nan tan du bya tshul dang 'gro phan byung dus kyang tshul bzhin ston pa la/ dpon slob 'brel ma brtag par dbang mi bskur/ dbang ma bskur bar gdams ngag mi ston/ gdams ngag ma bstan par gzhung mi 'chad/ gzhung ma bshad par lung sbyor mi ston la/ thams cad kyi rjes la lung sbyin te/ tshul bzhin du bskyangs pa'i dam bzhag bzhi mdzad pa/ chos rje sa paṇa gyi yi ge bzhin te pod dmar na bzhugs so// zhu brag dmar pa'i yi ger de'i tshe ske la phreng ba bskon/ mgon po'i sku'i mdun du dam bzhag byed zer te/ chos la gtsigs su byed pa'i don yin gsungs so// de ltar na lam 'bras kyi gzhung khrid kyi tshig thams cad tshang bar thob pa'i chig brgyud nyams myong rgyud la skyes pa'i don brgyud/ brda lkog tu khrid pa'i brda brgyud de/ brgyud pa gsum ldan la bsgrub pa'i bka' lung sbyin no// de ltar na de dag gis chos rje rin po che'i zhal snga nas mdzad 'phro sa bcad kha tshang ba tsam du bris pa yin no// 'o na rje nyid kyis tshang bar ma bkod pa ci yin snyam na/ 'dir dngos su bkod na legs mod kyi ma bkod kyang*/ rje sa skya pa man chod kyi bla ma'i rnam thar tshang ma yod pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas/ glegs bam mdzad yod pa dang*/ gdams ngag dngos la yang glegs bam che chung gnyis bshad thabs dang bcas pa zur du yod pa la dgongs pa 'dra'o// des na 'di'i thog mar dang po'i bla ma zhwa lugs pa yan chad kyi bla ma'i rnam thar zhib par bris 'dug pa bzhin/

'dir yang rje sa chen man chad kyi rnam thar tshang ba re dang*/ nyams len dngos la bshad sgrub kyi tshul zhib par bris na mang po rang yong ngo*// 'dir re zhig 'di tsam bris pas kyang*/ 'di skul ba po la sogs pa phyogs 'di la mos pa'i gdul bya bdag las blo dman pa mang po la phan thog par gyur cig/ //oṃ swa sti/ mdo rgyud spyi dang dpal ldan sa skya pa'i// rgyud gsum man ngag gang dang gang gi gzhung*// ma tshang ba dang 'thor ba legs bsdus nas// bstan pa rin chen bang mdzod legs 'dzin pa// rje btsun kun dga' bzang po yab sras rgyal// rgyal ba'i bstan pa mdo rgyud rgya mtsho yi// zab don rin chen bye ba'i lam bzang mchog /mkhas grub bye bas bshad sgrub gtan la phab// lam bzang de dag 'gro la gsal ba ni// lam skor dgu dang gnad du che ba drug /gzhan yang lam srol du ma byon pa las// rgya mtsho chen por nor bu'i tshogs bzhin du// gzhan gyis rab bsngags zab khyad kun dang ldan// gang la gang 'tsham ci dang ci dgos kyi// phun tshogs rgyal po lta bu'i lam bzang 'di// thog mar byung tshul bshad sgrub bya ba'i tshul// grub nas gzhan don byed tshul dang bcas pa// bla mas mdzad 'gro bla ma'i gsung sgros bzhin// bkod pa 'dis kyang bstan la phan par shog /kye ma deng sang chos 'dod rnams kyi 'jug tshul la// blun po phal cher chos dang mi 'phrad stong par 'gro// chos dang phrad pa phal cher 'gro ba bzhi yis 'gro// des na 'dis kyang gzhan la phan par ji ltar 'gyur// 'on kyang 'di yi rnam dbye 'di tsam bris pa ni// bod 'dir phyi dus lam 'bras pa zhes mang na yang*// dpe cha'i rnam grangs tsam yang ma mthong phyogs re tsam// kho bo'i bla ma rje de chos 'di'i bdag po ste// gzhan dang 'gran zla med par go bar bya phyir dang*// 'di'i bskul ba po dag dgyes pa bskyed phyir yin// bdag gi mkhas pa'i drung der lam bzang 'dir// 'bad pas ri la 'dzegs pas yongs su rdzogs// slar yang mig gis bltas pas phra zhib rnyed// de yi rgyal tshab dam pas spyan gyis gzigs// snga phyi'i bla ma dag gis de nyid bstan// thos bsam

83 'dod rong ston dang gzhon nu bas re rer gsum/ mthar pa sgrub la bdag blo dang*// dad pa de bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i man ngag gi byung tshul gsung ngag bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyi 'od ces bya ba 'di'i thog ma'i byung tshul phal che ba/ rje btsun kun dga'i mtshan can gyis zhal snga nas mdzad pa la/ rje btsun sa skya pa rnams kyis dar bar byas tshul man chod rje de nyid kyi gsung bzhin bris pa 'di yang spyir dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang pos bskul ba dang khyad par du tor sde dpon po khu dpon gyis rgyang ring po nas bskul ba'i ngor/ mdo dang sngags kyi tshul lugs man ngag bcas pa la kun mkhyen rong ston yab sras dang*/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang po yab sras kyi zhabs la gtugs pa gung ru shes rab bzang pos rings par bris pa 'dis kyang bstan pa dang 'gro ba mang po la phan thogs par gyur cig/ // ༄// lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i bshad thabs kyi man ngag bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i bshad thabs kyi man ngag gsang ba'i sgo 'byed ces bya ba/ rje btsun thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// mthu stobs dbang phyug gsung rab rin chen gter// zhal nas snyan du brgyud pa'i gdams ngag gis// skal ldan tshim mdzad bla mar gus btud nas// gsung ngag bshad thabs man ngag 'dir nges bya// 'dir dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab zab mo mdo sde dang rgyud sde thams cad kyi don gyi bcud phyung ba/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po rje btsun bir+wa pa'i gsung rab/ mkhas pa rnams kyis bgrod par bya ba'i 'jug ngogs/ mdo rgyud ma lus pa gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me/ bsod nams dang mi ldan pa rnams kyis rtogs par dka' ba/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa rnams kyi them skas/

rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag 'bras bu lam dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag gcig shes pas mang po shes pa'i gdams ngag skyon yon tan du bslang pa'i gdams ngag bar chad dngos grub tu len pa'i gdams ngag ting nge 'dzin ngo shes pas bsam gtan gyi gegs sel ba'i gdams ngag bar chad ngo shes pas bdud kyi gegs sel ba'i gdams ngag gser 'gyur gyi rtsi lta bu'i gdams ngag rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang*/ sde snod gsum gyi de nyid/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu'i gdams ngag 'di ni/ gang bshad pa dang nyan par bya ba'i chos yin no// de'ang rje btsun sa skya pa chen po'i lam 'bras don bsdus las/ tshad ma snyan brgyud bzhi yis spros pa gcod// ces gdams ngag gi spros pa thams cad tshad ma bzhis gcod par gsungs shing*/ bzhi po de nyid kyang dpal sam+bu ṭi'i rgyud las/ bstan bcos tshad ma slob dpon dang*// lung gi rjes 'brang de nyid rig /gsang don de nyid dngos po yang*// gcig nas gcig brgyud shes par bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// des na gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag rnams tshad ma bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su blang dgos pas/ de bshad na bzhi ste/ man ngag ston byed kyi bla ma tshad mar sgrub pa'i phyir/ bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus mnyan zhing mos gus bsgom pa dang*/ rnal 'byor pa rang gi rgyud la nyams myong tshad ma bskyed pa'i phyir/ khrid kyi rnal 'byor nyams su blang ba dang*/ nyams myong de nyid la nges shes khyad par can skyed pa'i phyir/ lo rgyus sam bstan bcos tshad ma gzhung rdo rje'i tshig rkang mnyan pa dang*/ bstan bcos de nyid la yid ches khyad par can bskyed pa'i phyir lung tshad ma dang sbyar te bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ bla ma rgya bod kyi rnam thar mnyan zhing mos gus bya ste/ rje btsun chen pos/

dang por bla ma tshad mar bya ba/ bla ma la mos gus tshud tshud bsgom par bya zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa la gsum/ nyams myong ma skyes par skyed par byed pa khrid kyi rnal 'byor/ skyes pa brtan par byed pa rtogs pa skyed pa'i chos lnga/ de dag gi bar chad sel bar byed pa gegs sel gyi yi ge bzhi bshad pa'o// dang po la bzhi/ gzhung ji lta ba bzhin du dkri ba'i gzhung shing*/ gnad drug gis dkri ba'i gzhung shing*/ gnad bcu gcig gis dkri ba'i gzhung shing*/ dbang po rab 'bring gsum du dkri ba'i gzhung shing ngo*// dang po la gnyis/ gzhung ji lta ba bzhin dkri ba dngos dang*/ de'i gnad bsdus nas nyams su blangs pa'i gdams ngag go /dang po gzhi dam tshig la gnas par bya ba la gnyis/ dam tshig dang sdom pa ma thob pa thob par byed pa dbang bskur ba dang*/ thob pa mi nyams par byed pa dam tshig gi tshogs bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ dbang gi chu bo'i lag len rgyas pa/ dbang bzhi'i cho ga mtha' dag mdor bsdus pa man ngag gi gnad mchog dbang gsum grol lam la rten te bskur ba/ yab kyi bskyed rim rgyas pa yan lag bzhi pa/ 'bring po yan lag drug pa/ bsdus pa yum gyi bskyed rim rnams la brten nas/ yab yum gyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur rnam par dag pa blang ngo*// gnyis pa la gsum/ bsrung ba'i dam tshig bza' ba'i dam tshig bsten pa'i dam tshig go /dang po ni/ rtsa ltung bcu bzhi yan lag gi ltung ba dang bcas pa'i 'grel pa 'khrul pa spangs pa ltar ro// gnyis pa la gnyis/ rgyun gyi bza' ba'i dam tshig dang*/ khyad par gyi bza' ba'i dam tshig go /dang po ni/ bdud rtsi ril bu sgrub pa'i gdams ngag go /gnyis pa ni/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga rnams zhib tu bshad cing bstan no// gsum pa ni/ lam rim pa gnyis tshul bzhin du nyams su len pa ste/ 'og tu nyams su len pa'i skabs las 'dir mi bshad do// lta bas spros pa bcad pa'i skabs su/

'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba rtsa 'grel gnyis/ lus thabs rgyud kyi skabs su/ lam sogs nyi shu po drangs nas bshad cing*/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa ni gsang dbang gi lam gyi thog mar bya'o// gnyis pa gnad bsdus te nyams su blangs pa'i gdams ngag ni/ lam 'bras khrid kyi snying po ni/ gnyis las gsum 'byung gdams ngag yin// kun gyi spyod yul ma yin pa'i// man ngag shes pa bla ma'i drin// zhes pa'i don/ bla ma mnyes par byas pa'i zhal las rim gyis shes par bya'o// gnyis pa la lnga/ lam 'jug ldog phyag rgya 'jug ldog shes pas phan 'dogs pa'i gdams ngag bdun/ lam bsre ba 'gros bzhi dang bcas pa/ phyi nang gi mdzad pa bcu gnyis rnams so// gsum pa la bzhi/ bsam gtan 'dor ba'i 'phrang bdun/ byung rgyal du mi btang ba'i gnad bzhi/ 'byung ba lus 'khrugs rlung dang spyod lam gyis bsal ba/ rnal 'byor phrin las sum cu so gnyis rnams so// man ngag de rnams kyi sgo nas nyams myong tshad ma zhig rgyud la ma skyes bar du bsgom mo// gsum pa la gnyis/ gzhung gi don rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ don bsdus nas bshad pa'o/ dang po la gnyis/ lam rgyas bsdus gsum du bstan pa dang*/ lam zab 'bring gsum du bstan pa'o// dang po la gsum/ lam rgyas pa/ 'bring po/ bsdus pa'o// dang po ni/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang*/ 'grel pa gnyags ma/ de'i bsdus don rnams sbyar la bshad cing*/ de'i skabs rnams su/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud/ gdan sogs/ lam sogs nyi shu la lus kyi dkyil 'khor/ bum dbang gi 'da' ka ma'i skabs su 'chi ltas/ 'khrul 'khor/ 'chi bslu dang bcas pa/ bum dbang gi snang ba bsgyur ba'i 'da' ka ma/ gsang dbang gi skabs su thig le'i rnal 'byor bzhi/ shes rab ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid/ dbang bzhi pa'i 'da' ka ma/ bum dbang dang thun mong du yi ges sgo dgag pa dang bcas pa/ bar do bzhi'i gdams ngag go

/lam dus kyi dbang*/ tshad ma bzhi/ gdams ngag drug rten 'brel lnga/ grib sel gyi sbyin sreg bsdus pa/ grib ma khrus kyis sel ba dang*/ sats+tshas sel ba/ thig le srung ba/ yi ge brgya pa'i 'don thabs so// 'jig rten pa'i lam gyi skabs su/ rlung gi sbyor ba bdun kyis lam khrid pa/ bha ga'i yi ge bcu bzhi/ 'das pa'i lam la/ gsang dbang gi skabs su/ 'khor bzhi'i rgya/ bzhi pa'i skabs su/ dbang phyug gi don brgyad/ sa bcu gsum pa'i phyed kyi mngon rtogs rnams sbyar te bshad pas gzhung gi don lhag ma med par rtogs par 'gyur ro// gsum pa lam zab 'bring gsum du bstan pa ni/ tha ma lus so sor rtog pa'i 'gog pa dang*/ 'bring dam tshig gi lam gnyis ni gong du bshad tshar bas 'dir bstan mi dgos la/ rab bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi lam ni/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ro// gnyis pa mdor bsdus nas bshad pa ni/ lam 'bras don bsdus ma'o// bzhi pa la gsum/ lung 'di nyid dang zhib tu sbyar ba dang*/ mdor bsdus te sbyar ba dang*/ lung mtha' dag dang mdor bsdus te sbyar ba'o// de ltar na lam 'bras glegs bam du gdams ngag gi yi ger thor bur gsungs pa ni/ snyan brgyud la gces spras su bya ba dang*/ phyi rabs kyi gang zag glegs bam tsam la brten nas gdams ngag la rang dgar 'jug pa ldog pa'i phyir mdzad pa yin la/ rang gi ngo bo gdams ngag phran tshegs 'di thams cad gcig tu byas nas/ rten gyi gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i cha rkyen ma lus pa ston pa'i lam gyi rim pa gcig tu ston cing 'chad shes na/ man ngag phran tshigs su mi 'gro zhing*/ lam mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa mtha' dag rdzogs par 'byung bas/ nyams len gyi gnad shin tu che la/ gdams ngag ltar snang ba cung zad kyis blo mgu mi thub pa cig 'byung bas/ rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam gyi 'brel sgrig tshul rmad du byung ba 'di nyams su blang bar rigs so// rje btsun gdams ngag nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis// bdag blo'i pad tshal rnam par rgyas byas pas// lam gyi 'brel bsgrigs ge sar snying po byung*// rkang drug ldan pa'i don gnyer dga' bar mdzod// snang byed dbus na rta bdun rgyal po ltar// lam bzang dbus na gsung ngag rin chen gter// rdo rje lta bur shin tu rtogs dka' zhing*// yid bzhin nor ltar dgos 'dod kun stsol ba'i// lam 'di dag las phyi rol gyur pa las// rmad byung 'bras bu thob par ma nges nas// 'bad pas lam 'di gsal bar byas pa'i mthus// 'gro kun rdo rje 'chang chen sa thob shog

/ces pa 'di ni dad pa dang ldan pa'i slob ma dam tshig can 'ga' zhig gis bskul ba'i ngor/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rje btsun bla ma dam pa ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos gus pas blangs pa shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos bla ma dam pa brgyud pa dang bcas pa la gsol ba btab cing*/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la mchod gtor mang du phul ba'i rjes la yi ger bkod pa 'di yongs su rdzogs so/// / ༄// dbang bzhi'i rtogs bskyed bzhugs so// ༈ /rje btsun bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis zhal snga nas/ dbang re re'i mjug tu yang*/ bla ma gang yin pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor dang*/ dbang dang*/ dri ma dang*/ dpe dang*/ yon tan dang*/ lam dang*/ lta ba dang*/ 'da' ka ma dang*/ bar do dang*/ dam tshig dang*/ brda dang*/ grub mtha' dang*/ 'gros dang 'bras bu gang yin pa zhes bya ba bco lnga bco lnga'i rtogs pa brjod par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa las/ sbyang gzhi gang yin pa zhes pa bsnan nas bcu drug tu byas te/ dbang dang po la de ltar na sbyang gzhi rtsa lus kyi dkyil 'khor la/ phyi sgro 'dogs yongs su gcod pa'i bla mas/ rdul tshon nam dbyibs kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang bskur bas/ lus kyi dri ma dag dpe zhing sa gshin pa dang 'dra/ yon tan brgya phrag bdun dang bye ba phrag bdun la sogs pa la dbang 'byor/ lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ lta ba ngo bo nyid gsum/ 'da' ka ma gong du 'pho ba/ bar do bdag yi dam dang sems ro gcig pa/ dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis bsrung ba/ brda lnga bsdus rtse mos mnan pa/ grub mtha' 'khor 'das dbyer med/ rtsa'i 'gros mchog tu thim/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku rang bzhin lhun grub kyi rten 'brel mngon du byas so// zhes so// dbang gnyis pa la/ sbyang gzhi yi ge bha ga'i dkyil 'khor la/

nang rang byung gi ye shes ston pa'i bla mas/ gzhan bdag 'jug las/ gsang dbang la bha ga'i dkyil 'khor zhes gsungs kyang*/ 'dir gong mas byang sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsungs pa ni byang sems kyi dbang bskur ba la dgongs la/ dbang gsum la bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du gsungs pa ni/ phyag rgya'i bha ga'i dkyil 'khor bstan pas lhan skyes kyi ye shes rtogs pa la dgongs shing*/ dkyil chog sna mang por yang de bzhin du gsungs pas/ 'thad par sems so// kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang bskur bas ngag gi dri ma dag dpe zhing sa gshin pa la sa bon btab pa dang 'dra/ yon tan nus pa lnga dang lta stangs la thogs pa med pa/ tshig gi mchog 'grub/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi la dbang thob/ lam rang byin rlabs bsgom pa la dbang*/ lta ba rang byung gi ye shes/ 'da' ka ma 'od gsal ba/ bar do rang byung gi ye shes 'od gsal ba rtog med/ dam tshig sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i ril bu bsten pa/ brda mtheb srin e la reg byed/ grub mtha' ma 'dres la yongs su rdzogs pa/ yi ge'i 'gros mchog tu thim/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rang bzhin lhun grub kyi rten 'brel mngon du byas so// zhes pa'o// dbang gsum pa la/ sbyang gzhi khams bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor la/ gsang ba lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ston pa'i bla mas/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur bas/ yid kyi dri ma dag dpe sa bon la myu gu smin pa dang 'dra/ yon tan sku gsum ye shes lnga la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi yon tan ci rigs pa la dbang 'byor/ lam dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgom pa la dbang*/ lta ba yas bab kyi dga' ba bzhi/ 'da' ka ma nam 'chi ba'i tshe rdo rje sems dpa' 'byon par 'gyur ba/ bar do lhan skyes kyi ye shes/ dam tshig bud med la mi smod pa/ brda byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya/

grub mtha' bde stong chung ngu*/ bdud rtsi'i 'gros mchog tu thim/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku rang bzhin lhun grub kyi rten 'brel mngon du byas so// zhes so/ dbang bzhi pa la sbyang gzhi snying po ye shes rlung gi dkyil 'khor la mthar thug de kho na nyid chos thams cad shin tu rnam par dag pa ston pa'i bla mas/ don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du tshig dbang rin po che bzhi pa bskur bas/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag dpe myu gu la lo tog phun sum tshogs pa dang 'dra/ yon tan sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor los sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad la dbang 'byor/ lam rdo rje'i rba rlabs bsgom pa la dbang*/ lta ba mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi/ 'da' ka ma phyag rgya chen pos 'pho ba/ bar do bde stong gi ye shes/ dam tshig dgongs te gsungs pa mtha' dag brda mdzub mos nam mkha' mtshon/ grub mtha' bde stong rgya chen po/ rlung gi 'gros mchog tu thim/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku rang bzhin lhun grub kyi rten 'brel mngon du byas so// zhes so// rgyu dus kyi dbang gi rtogs pa bskyed pa'i rim pa/ sngar byon pa'i lam 'bras pa chen po 'ga' res mdzad du zin kyang*/ bco lnga po thams cad rdzogs par ma mdzad par snang bas/ 'dir bla ma rje btsun chen po'i dgongs pa ltar shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos dpal sa skyar sbyar ba re zhig rdzogs so/// / ༄// tsa tur da sha nā dā nāṃ he badz+ra s+ya bi dza ha raṃ// ༈ /he badz+rā ya na ma/ mthu stobs dbang phyug man ngag gi /mngon par rtogs pa bcu bzhi ni// bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi pa dang*// de bzhin yan lag drug pa gnyis// dang po yan lag bzhi pa la// gang zag dbang po rab dang ni// 'bring dang tha ma'i bye brag gis// bskyed tshul cung zad mi 'dra ste// dang po rgyu yi rdo rje 'chang*// rab kyis bdud bzhi'i gdan steng du// skad cig tsam gyis nag por bskyed// 'bring gi dbus dang phyogs mtshams su// ā li kā li spangs pa yi// zla nyi kha sbyor dgu bsams te// dbus kyi zla nyi'i bar du ni// oṃ dang hūm̐ las phyag mtshan gnyis// sa bon gyis mtshan gcig tu 'dres// de las yab yum nag por bsgom// tha mas bsgom bya'i mngon rtogs la// mi mnyam sbyor dang mnyam sbyor gnyis// dang po ā li kā li las// byung ba'i zla nyi kha sbyor dgu// bsam zhing gzhan rnams sngar ltar bsgom// gnyis pa mnyam sbyor la dbus su// zla ba gru gsum nyis brtsegs dang*// phyogs mtshams brgyad du sa bon las// byung ba'i zla nyi kha sbyor bsam// dbus steng hūm̐ byung rdo rje dkar// de las gtso bo dkar por bskyed// de nas mkha' gsang byin brlabs nas// 'khor gyi lha mo dbyung ba ni// rab kyis phyogs mtshams gdan steng du// yum gyi mkha' yi thig le brgyad// lha mo rnams su gyur nas spro// 'bring gi sngar bskyed zla nyi yi// bar du mkha' nas thig le brgyad// spro ba'am yang na sa bon spro// de las phyag mtshan sa bon gyis// mtshan pa brgyad gyur so sor 'dres// de las lha mo brgyad du bskyed// tha mas 'bring bzhin dbyung ba'o// de nas rgyu yi rdo rje 'chang*// thig ler zhu ba glus bskul bas// 'bras bu rdor 'dzin bzhengs pa ni// rab kyis thig le las bzhengs shing*// 'bring gis thig le cha gsum du// gyur pa'i 'og ma zla ba dang*// steng ma nyi ma bar ma ni// phyag mtshan rnams su gyur las bzhengs// tha mas 'bring dang 'dra ba las// zla nyi gnyis la sa bon sbyar// lhag ma rtse mo rgyas pa bzhin// gnyis pa yan lag drug pa la// sngar bzhin sgom thabs rnam gsum ste// rab kyis rgyu yi rdo rje 'chang*// yab yum hūm̐ dang oṃ las bskyed// 'bring gis sa bon spangs pa dang*// tha mas sa bon las byung ba'i// mi mnyam sbyor dang mnyam sbyor sogs// thams cad sngar dang 'dra ba las// 'khor gyi mngon byang dor ba dang*// rgyu yi rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams// dkar zhing yum rnams nag mor bskyed// 'khor gyi lha mo dbyung ba ni// rab kyis yum gyi mkha' nang gi

/thig le sa bon du gyur cing*// de dag lha mor gyur las spro// 'bring dang tha mas thams cad la// bha ga'i nang gi thig le rnams// lha mor gyur nas spro ba'am// yang na sa bon spro bar bya// 'bras bu'i rdor 'dzin bzhengs pa ni// rab 'bring tha ma thams cad la// thig le yi ger gyur pa las// nag por bsam zhing lhag ma rnams// rje btsun chen po'i 'bring po bzhin// tshul 'di dge slong rgyud gsum pas// rnam bshad dag ldan dgongs pa ltar// nor 'khrul med par bris pa yi// dge bas rdo rje 'dzin thob shog// / ༄// phyi nang gi bskyed rim dbang dang bcas pa'i sdom tshig bzhugs// ༈ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdor sems bsgom// gsum ni spyi yi sngon 'gro yin// tshogs gnyis bsags dang srung 'khor bskyed// gzhal yas dur gdan mngon byang bsgom// 'khor gyi lha spro thig ler zhu// glus bskul 'bras bu rdor 'dzin bskyed// snod bcud sbyang dang mig sogs bskyed// ye shes bkug la lus dkyil bsgom// dbang lha spyan drangs mchod bstod bya// chu dang cod paṇa rdo rje dang*// dril bu ming dang brtul zhugs te// rnam pa drug ni slob ma'i dbang*// yon dbul gsol gdab lha ru bsgom// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yi// dam tshig gsum sbyin chu dbang bskur// rgyas gdab mchod la dbang don bshad// rnam pa bcu ni slob dpon dbang*// yon dbul gsol gdab gsang dbang bskur// don bshad rnam bzhi gsang ba'i dbang*// yon dbul gsol gdab phyag rgya gtad// dris lan tshig gnyis 'du shes bsgyur// dga' bzhi dran zhing dbang don bshad// rnam pa brgyad ni gsum pa'i dbang*// yon dbul gsol gdab bsam gtan bsgom// don bshad bzhi ni bzhi pa'i dbang*// rgyas gdab rnam gnyis nga rgyal bzung*// bdud rtsi byin rlabs mchod bstod bya/ rdzogs rim bsgom rnams dngos gzhi'o// dag pa bzlas brjod dkyil 'khor bsdu// rang nyid gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis// rdo rje'i glu dang bkra shis dang*// bsngo ba smon lam tshul bzhin bya// thun rjes 'das dang 'jig rten pa'i// lha la gtor ma ci nus dbul// dus kun lha yi nga rgyal gyis// chos mthun spyod pas gnas par bya// zhes pa 'di'ang spong ba pa kun dga' bzang pos sbyar ba'o/// /

༄// lam zab nang gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ gang gi drin gyis lhan skyes bde ba che// skad cig nyid la 'char bar mdzad pa yi// rje btsun rtsa ba'i bla ma la btud nas// lam zab nang gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor bshad// 'dir rje btsun mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal bir+wa pas/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal sa skya pa la dngos su gnang ba'i gdams ngag zab mo nang gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su len par 'dod na/ stan bde ba la bsam gtan gyi yan lag gis 'dug la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ rang skad cig gis kye rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ dpal he ru ka dang bla ma tha mi dad pa mdun du spyan drangs la/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyis mchod/ gus btud drag po byas te bdag nyid la thim pas/ rang gi lus skad cig gi dkyil 'khor lus dkyil las 'byung ba ltar/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje bsgom pa nas/ rkang mthil gnod mdzes su bsam pa'i bar shin tu gsal bar bsgoms nas/ rang gi spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma nas rdo rje 'chang gi bar gyi brgyud pa rnams kyi rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam pa can/ 'og ma'i spyi bor gong ma bzhugs pa tho brtsegs kyi tshul du bsams la/ de rnams la mos gus drag tu bya zhing*/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa bsdus nas bla ma rnams la thim par bsgom/ de nas rdo rje 'chang bdag med ma la thim/ de bir+wa pa la/ de rje btsun sa skya pa chen po la thim/ de nas rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim pa'i bar byas nas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ bla ma dam pas bdag la bum pa'i dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/

bla ma yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ bde chen gyi 'khor lo'i dbus na rnam par snang mdzad yab yum dang*/ rtsa 'dab rnams la lha mo so gnyis yod pa la thim par bsams la/ lha rnams gsal gdab/ rlung bum pa can bzung la/ byang sems des smin mtshams yan chad gang*/ lus kyi dri ma dag bum pa'i dbang thob par bsam mo// yang spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ gsang ba'i dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sbyor mtshams nas byang sems kyi chu rgyun byung*/ mgrin pa'i 'khor lo'i lha rnams la thim par bsams la/ lha rnams gsal gdab/ bum pa can bzung la/ byang sems kyis mgrin pa yan chad gang*/ ngag gi dri ma dag gsang ba'i dbang thob par bsam mo// de bzhin du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ yang sbyor mtshams nas byang sems kyi chu rgyun byung*/ snying ga'i 'khor lo'i lha rnams la thim par bsams la/ lha rnams gsal gdab/ bum pa can bzung la/ byang sems kyis snying ga yan chad gang*/ yid kyi dri ma dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob par bsam mo// de bzhin du dbang bzhi pa bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma yab yum bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du zhu nas/ lte ba dang*/ gsang gnas dang*/ dbang po dang*/ yan lag gi lha rnams la thim par bsams la/ lha rnams gsal gdab/ bum pa can byas la/ byang sems des spyi bo nas rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag dbang bzhi pa thob par bsam mo// de nas lta ba ci nus su bskyangs la dge ba bsngo ba sogs bya'o// de ltar na dbang bzhi po re re la'ang lam bzhi char tshang ba yin te/ lha'i rnam pa la sems 'dzin pa bum dbang gi lam/ rlung bum pa can du bya ba gsang dbang gi lam/ rang rang gi 'khor lo rnams byang sems kyis khyab par byas pa gsum pa'i lam/ de dag las lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes skyes pa ni bzhi pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir ro// zab mo nang gi bla ma sgrub pa'i thabs// snyan brgyud yi ger bris la nyes pa gang*// bla ma mkha' 'gro'i spyan sngar bdag 'chags shing*// dge bas dpal ldan bla ma mnyes byed shog

/nang gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi gdams ngag lam 'bras kyi bcud bsdus pa lta bu 'di ni/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bran du gyur pa shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos sbyar ba'o/// / ༄// rje btsun bir+wa pa'i srung ba'i man ngag bar chad kun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /rje btsun bir+wa pa'i srung ba'i man ngag bar chad kun sel zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi mthu stobs ye shes rdo rje yis// bdud dang mu stegs tshogs kun 'dul mdzad pa'i// dpal ldan bir+wa pa la gus btud nas// de yi man ngag gsal bar bri bar bya// 'dir rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po dpal ldan bir+wa pas/ bla ma rje btsun sa skya pa chen po la dngos su gnang ba'i man ngag rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi chos bzhi'am/ lcags ri'i khongs kyi chos zab bzhir grags pa'i nang nas/ 'dir dpal ldan bir+wa pa nyid kyi man ngag rnams bshad par bya ba la/ spyi don gsum ste/ thog mar man ngag gi lung blang ba/ lung thob nas bsgom bzlas bya ba/ bsgom bzlas mthar phyin nas srung ba rnams bya ba'o// dang po ni/ 'di'i lung dang man ngag rnams thob cing*/ bsgom bzlas ma chags pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ nyi shu dgu'am gnam gang gi dus su gnas dben par mchod gtor rgya cher bshams la/ lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa nas lhag gtor gyi bar tshogs kyi 'khor lo tshul bzhin du byas pa'i mthar/ rje btsun gyi bsgom bzlas dang srung ba rnams bya'o// de nas dbang gis smin pa'i slob ma khrus byas pas/ slob dpon rdo rje 'chang du mos pa la/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal lan gsum phul nas/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs gsum gyis rgyun bshags dang*/ sems bskyed nas/ bla ma rnal 'byor dbang phyug tu bsgom pa'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug la/

rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs nas/ gnyis su med par thim par bsams la/ slob mas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/ rje btsun mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug bir+wa pas/ bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i sku las rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi sku dpag tu med pa byon nas rang la thim pas sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag par mos la/ bla mas rdo rje dril bu bsil zhing*/ rtsa ba'i sngags sam aṣ+ṭa bzla'o// yang bla ma'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byon/ rang gi snying gar thim pas/ rje btsun gyi byin rlabs zhugs par bsams la/ bla ma'i rjes su badz+ra aṃ gu li sogs kyi sngags lan gsum bzlas pas gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag par bsam mo// de nas bla ma rje btsun bir+wa par mos pa de nyid rang gi smin mtshams su thim pas/ rang bir+wa par gyur par bsgoms la/ lus bir+wa pa'i stangs ka bya/ ngag rlung kha sbyor thub tshad bzung*/ sems kyis rang bir+wa pa yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal gyis gang la nyam nga ba dang*/ bag tsha ba med par bsams pas thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag par bsam mo// de nas sgrub thabs dang srung ba'i man ngag rnams byin nas/ bsgom bzlas ma chags par gyis shig ces bsgos la/ maṇ+ḍal lan gsum dang yon dbul ba la sogs pa rjes kyi bya ba rnams rdzogs par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ srod dang tho rangs kyi tshe/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pa rnams sngon du song nas/ oṃ swa bhā was stong par bsam pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i khri seng ges bteg pa'i steng du/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/

rje btsun mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa/ sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pa'i mthil gdan steng du mnan cing*/ g.yon pas sdigs mdzub gyen du bstan pa/ sku 'gying bag dang ldan pa la/ me tog sna tshogs kyi dbu rgyan dang*/ do shal byas shing*/ pus 'khyud dang bcas pa'i zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par bsams la/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa spyan drangs pa nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i bar gong ltar byas la/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun rnal 'byor dbang phyug la rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥrang la gnyis su med par thim/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo rje btsun mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug bir+wa pas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sngags kyi sgra grags stong la sems gtad nas/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ gu li/ badz+ra ka pa li/ badz+ra dhi na/ bhan dhu ha ra/ badz+ra pi aṃ/ hūm̐ tsaṃ ge sa ra bhe rta dha/ kha ge e/ aṃ ge mi li/ la ga pa ra ta/ ta u la/ ti pā ta/ oṃ bhi ru wa/ wa pa ra/ na mo be dha ni/ wa ra ṇa/ zhes tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod par dam bca' ji tsam yod kyi bar bzlas pa'i mthar/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs// yon tan phrin las gcig tu bsdus pa'i dngos// bla ma rnams dang dpal ldan bir+wa pa// gnyis su med la bdag ni skyabs su mchi// mgon po khyod kyi thugs dang bdag gi sems// dbye ba med par gcig tu 'dres gyur nas// phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba khyod ci 'dra// bdag kyang de 'drar 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes drag tu gsol ba btab nas/ rang la bstim pa'am/ mi dmigs pa gang bde bya gsung yang*/

'dir rang la bstims pas rang rnal 'byor dbang phyug tu bsam pa sogs gong ltar byas pa'i rjes la/ srung ba rnams mdzad do// bla ma kha cig gsol ba btab pa'i rjes su/ lam zab bla ma las gsungs pa ltar zhen pa spang ba dang*/ dbang dang dngos grub blangs nas rang la bstim nas bsrung ba rnams mdzad de dpyad par bya'o// gsum pa la bcu gnyis kyi dang po khyor chus srung ba ni/ lag pa g.yon par chu gtsang khyor ba gang blugs la/ dpung pa g.yon par bzung la mig gis mi blta bar/ srin lag g.yas pas g.yas skor du bkrug cing*/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ gu li sogs lan gsum bzlas nas/ rang gi mig gis ma mthong bar srin lag des gnas gsum du thig le bya zhing*/ chu lhag ma sna bug g.yon nas rlung brngubs pas btung bar bya'o// gnyis pa dri chus srung ba ni/ lag pa g.yon par dri chu blugs la/ g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis g.yas skor du mnye zhing sngags bdun nam/ nyer gcig bzlas nas mig mi blta bar mtheb srin g.yas pas chu blangs la/ de mig gis ma mthong bar/ phrag gong nas rgyab na phar bskor la/ thog mar lce thog tu bzhag de nas/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ rnams bsgoms la gnas de dag tu mtheb srin gyis thig le byas la byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo// 'di la yi ge rnying pa las/ khyor ba g.yas par dri chu blugs nas/ g.yon pas dkrugs pa sogs bshad de dpyad par bya'o// gsum pa dri chu bar pas srung ba ni/ dang po lag pa g.yon par dri chu bar pa blugs pa la/ g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis g.yas skor du dkrug cing*/ sngags nyer gcig bzlas nas/ mdun nas g.yas skor gyis thog mar lce la reg de nas/ dpral bar haṃ/ mgrin par oṃ/ snying gar hūm̐/ lte bar a/ gsang gnas su ha bsams nas gnas de dag tu thig le byas pas yi ge lnga las 'od kyi srid bus mdud pa byas pas/ bar chad kyis mi tshugs par bsgom/ de nas lag pa g.yas par dri chu bar pa blugs la g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis g.yon skor du dkrug cing*/

sngags nyer gcig bzlas nas rgyab nas g.yon skor gyis lce la reg pa sogs sngar bzhin bya'o// bzhi pa rdo rje rtse gsum gyis srung ba ni/ g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung mthe bos mnan la/ sor mo gsum phral te brkyang pa dpral bar reg la/ ak+ṣe bi ma/ kha la reg la/ pa tshe u pa ma/ snying gar reg la/ shi la pa thār/ lte bar reg la/ ha u a tshe u/ ling gar reg la/ wa pa/ zhes pas yas rim dang*/ yang liṅgar reg la/ bir+wa/ lte bar/ pa/ snying gar/ pra/ kha la/ sa dheṃ/ dpral bar swā hā/ zhes brjod la mas rim gyis reg go /mchan rnying kha cig la/ gnas lngar/ pho brang lnga'i gtso bo rnams bsgoms nas sngags brjod cing*/ phyag rgyas reg pas lha rnams gsal gdab par bya zhes 'byung ngo*// lnga pa rnal 'byor srung ba'i phyag rgyas srung ba ni/ rdo rje srung ba'i phyag rgya ni// snying gar bcas te bshang skor dgrol// 'byung po'i nyi ma dag la bsten// gzhan du na ni bar chad 'gyur// zhes pa'i don/ rkang mthil gnyis sprad/ pus mo phyir bskyed la rlung kha sbyar du byas nas/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje phyir bsdams las/ mthe bong gnyis gung mo gnyis/ mthe'u chung gnyis rnams rtse sprad pa'i phyag rgya snying gar bcas la/ sngags rnams yid kyis bzlas shing*/ mthe bong sbyar ba snying gar reg la/ ak+ṣe bhi ma/ gung mo kha dang*/ pa tshe u pa ma/ mthe'u chung lte ba dang*/ shi la pa thār/ gung mo liṅga dang*/ ha u a tshe u/ mthe'u chung bshang sgo dang*/ wa pa/ zhes yas rim dang*/ yang mthe'u chung bshang sgo dang*/ bir+wa/ gong mo liṅga dang*/ pa/ mthe'u chung lte ba dang*/ pra/ mthe bong snying ga dang*/ sa dheṃ/ gung mo kha dang*/ swā hā/ zhes mas rim dang*/ yang gong bzhin/ snying ga nas bshang sgo'i bar reg la/ der wa pa/ zhes yid kyis bzlas shing rlung btang*/ se gol gtogs par bya'o// 'di ni gong ma'i gsung ltar bris pa yin la/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po ltar na/ rkang pa'i brang nga sa la btsugs/

rting pa 'phong la gtad/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje bsdams pa las/ mthe bong mdzub mo mthe'u chung rnams rtse sprad nas/ brkyang pa'i phyag rgya snying gar bcas la/ der yar bzlog cing mdzub mo snying gar reg mthe'u chung lce la reg cing mar bzlog nas mthe'u chung dang mthe bong lte bar reg cing*/ bol+la la mtheb mdzub kyi bar nas phyung la/ mthe'u chung bshang lam du reg par bya'o// de ltar lan gsum byas la/ bshang lam du dgrol bar bzhed de/ 'di gnyis gang dag brtag go /drug pa sngags dang phyag rgyas srung ba ni/ rkang pa g.yon gyi ming med gcig shos kyis mnan/ tsog pur 'dug ste lag pa'i mthe bong gnyis kyis srin lag gnyis kyi rtsa ba mnan nas mthe'u chung bskum/ gung mo srin lag gsum brkyang nas/ phyag rgya gnyis rtse sprad pa snying gar bca' zhing*/ ra ga ta dza ṭa/ ra ga ta phaṭa/ bir+wa pa ka ni la phaṭa/ mo na thi bha ya/ zhes pa lan gsum mam bdun brjod pa'i mthar sor mo g.yon pa gsum gan rkyal byas pa'i steng du/ g.yas pa lan gsum brdab cing sngags bzlas/ de nas srin lag mthe bos mnan pa ma shor bar phyir lan gsum dkrug yang mthe bos srin lag mnan pa ma shor bar g.yon pa'i srin lag gis sna bug g.yas pa bkag la/ sna g.yon nas rlung lan gsum 'bud par bya'o// bdun pa dmigs pas srung ba ni/ spyi gtsug gi haṃ mgo thur la bstan pas dbu ma'i yar rtse bkag lte ba'i aṃ mgo gyen la lta bas/ mas sna bkag pa la dmigs pa gtad do// brgyad pa thabs shes rab gnyis med kyis srung ba ni/ rang gi spyi bor nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ thabs kyi rang bzhin ho dmar po mgo thur du bstan pa/ lte bar nyi ma'i steng du shes rab kyi rang bzhin ho dmar po mgo gyen du bstan par bsgom/ de nas lag pa g.yas pa'i sor mo gshibs pas lce'i bud bzhar g.yon pas kyang bud bzhar la/ lag pa g.yas pas spyi gtsug nas mnan/ g.yon pas lte ba bteg la/

yar mar nas gzir la/ thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa la blo gzhag par bya'o// dgu pa 'gro ba'i tshe srung ba ni/ rang gi bshang lam du k+ṣamarayuṃdakar po mgo gyen la bstan pa/ rdo rje la samarayuṃ ser po mgo gyen du bsten/ lte bar k+ṣuṃ dmar po mgo sprad pa/ khar suṃ dkar po/ sna gnyis la yuṃ ser po re re/ mig gnyis su hūm̐ sngon po re re/ rna ba gnyis su yuṃ dmar po re re/ mdzod spur samarayuṃdakar po mgon thur la bstan pa/ spyi gtsug tu hamarayuṃdakar po mgo thur la bstan pa/ thams cad zla ba'i gdan la gnas par bsams nas/ phyogs rnam par gnon pa'i phyir rlung mi rgyu ba ngos kyi rkang pa mnan/ rgyu ba ngos kyi lag pa thal mo phyar nas gom pa bdun du 'phags shing*/ ngag tu hūm̐ zhes brjod pa'o// bcu pa nyal ba'i tshe srung ba ni/ gzhogs g.yas pa 'og tu bcug la/ g.yas pa'i mthe'u chung gis sna bug g.yas pa bkag nas nyal bar bya'o// bcu gcig pa gza' rigs srung ba ni/ rang nyi ma steng gnon gyi phyag rgya byas pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis spyi bo'i thad du thog ris rtse lnga pa cig bris pa'i dbus su oṃ/ zur lnga la g.yon skor du/ na swa bho hūm̐ phaṭa/ rnams ser po mgo phyir bstan du dmigs la/ oṃ na swa bho hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces stong phrag gcig bzlas la 'khor lo spyi bor thim par bsgom/ yang sdigs mdzub kyi rtse mos rin po che zur brgyad pa bris pa'i zur rnams su/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ha hi hu he ho haḥ ces pa mgo nang bstan kha dog ser por bsgoms la/ sngags de nyid stong phrag gcig bzlas te/ dpung pa g.yas la thim par bsam/ 'khor lo de gnyis dar dmar po la gser gyis bris nas spyi bor bcing bar bya'o// bcu gnyis pa 'khor los srung ba ni/ rgya shog la gi waṃ gis 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa mu khyud dang bcas pa bris la lte bar ak+ṣe bi ma/ rtsibs bzhi la/ shar du pa tshe u pa ma/ lhor shi la pa thār/

nub tu ha u/ byang du a tshe u/ mu khyud la wa pa bir+wa pa pra sa dheṃ swā hā/ zhes pa rnams bris pa'am/ yang na 'khor lo'i lte bar bsgrub bya bris la/ de'i gnas lngar sngags lnga bris la/ spyi gtsug tu rin po che 'bar ba cha dgu pa bris la/ cha re la/ wa pa/ bir+wa pa/ pra sa dheṃ swā hā/ zhes pa rnams bri/ rtsibs bzhi dang mu khyud sogs la sngar bzhin bris la/ rab gnas byas la mgul du bcang bar bya'o// srung ba 'di thams cad la rang rnal 'byor dbang phyug tu bsgoms la/ de'i nga rgyal dang ma bral bar srung ba rnams bya ba ni gal che'o// zab mo sbas pa'i man ngag khyad par can// gsal bar bris la nyes gang bla ma dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis brtse bas bzod mdzod la// thugs rje chen pos bdag la byin gyis rlobs// 'dir 'bad dge ba bdag gis gang thob des// deng nas bzung ste sku gsum ma thob par// mthu stobs dbang phyug gsung gi mdzod 'dzin zhing*// lam gyi bar chad ma lus zhi bar shog /ces pa 'di yang rmad du byung ba'i yon tan gyi tshogs la dbang 'byor pa/ bla ma kun dga' legs pa'i bkas yang yang bskul ba la brten nas/ rje btsun gong ma'i yi ge thor bu pa rnams dang*/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che dang dkar shākya grags kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rnams las man ngag rnams tshang par bsdus shing*/ bla ma dam pa'i phyag len khyad par can gyis brgyan nas/ rdo rje 'chang chen po rje btsun rtog med zhabs la sogs pa bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' drin las gsung ngag rin po che man ngag dang bcas pa rnams kyi mdzod 'dzin pa shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos sbyar ba'o// thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag gcig brgyud ma dang bir srung gsar pa'i man ngag ni zur du shes par bya'o/// / ༄// sku'i rnam 'gyur drug gi zin bris bzhugs// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ dpal ldan bir+wa pa'i sku'i rnam 'gyur la drug ste/

nyi ma gteng par 'dzud pa/ gaṅgā bzlog pa/ chos 'chad pa/ gser 'gyur/ lha rten dgas pa/ mu stegs kyi lha mnan pa'o// dang po ni sku mdog dmar nag g.yas sdigs mdzub can/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o// gnyis pa ni sku mdog sngo nag phyag g.yas pa'i mthil gdan steng du mnan cing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub gyen du bstan pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung can no// gsum pa ni/ phyag gnyis thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o// bzhi pa ni/ g.yas gdan steng du mnan cing*/ g.yon khu tshur bcangs nas pus mo g.yon pa'i steng du bzhag pa/ zhabs gnyis skyil krung cung zad krong nge bar byas pa'o// lnga pa ni/ g.yas dpral bar thal mo sbyar/ g.yon gdan la brten pa sems dpa'i skyil krung can no// drug pa ni/ phyag gnyis kyi mthe bos mthe'u chung mnan pa/ rdo rje rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya byas la/ de gnyis thugs kar sbyar ba/ zhabs g.yon gyi srin mdzub g.yas kyi srin mdzub kyis mnan pa'o// gong ma min pa thams cad kyi sku mdog sngo nag gam sngo skya gang rung du bsam mo// de ltar sku'i rnam 'gyur drug po rang gang mos par bsgoms la sngags bzlas pa dang srung ba rnams bya ba gsungs so// zhes pa rnal 'byor pa rin chen rdo rjes gong ma'i gsung thor bu pa rnams las btus pa'o/// / ༄// byin rlabs bya tshul bzhugs// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul gcig bsdus pa// rnal 'byor dbang phyug la btud nas// de yi byin rlabs man ngag bri// 'byung po'i nyi ma gang rung la// dben par rim gnyis rnal 'byor bsgom// khyad par 'di yi bsgom bzlas dang*// tshogs kyi 'khor lo tshul bzhin bya// dbang gis smin pa'i slob ma kun// khrus byas phyag dang maṇ+ḍal dbul// kun mkhyen ye shes phung sogs kyis// gsol ba gdab cing rgyun bshags dang*// sdom pa gzung ba rnams kyang bya// slob dpon rnal 'byor dbang phyug tu// bsgoms pa'i dpral mgrin snying ga dang*// lte gsang rnams su oṃ āḥhūm̐// aṃ dang ha ste 'bru lnga bsgom// gus 'dud drag pos gsol btab pas// dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od dkar 'phros// slob ma'i dpral bar thim pa'i mthus// bum pa'i dbang bskur thob par bsgom// ngag dang sems la'ang de 'gres sbyar// lte gsang yi ge'i 'od zer dag

/slob ma'i lte gsang du thim pas// bzhi pa'i dbang mchog thob par bsam// de rjes slob dpon rang nyid la// thim par bsgom zhing nga rgyal bya// 'khor lo lnga dang rtsa gsum gyi// bsrung ba man ngag bzhin du sbyin// dam bca' khas blang yon dbul sogs// rjes kyi bya ba gzhan dang mthun// 'di yang slob mas gsol btab nas// gsung ngag zab mo'i mdzod 'dzin pa// dge slong kun dga' bzang pos bris// dge des 'gro kun lam bsgom shog /shu bha mastu sarba dza ga taṃ/// / ༄/ de'i nyams len bzhugs// ༈ /rje btsun mthu stobs kyi mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di'i man ngag la gnyis/ rang gzhan srung ba dang*/ byad bzlog pa'o// dang po la khyor chus srung ba dang*/ srung skud kyi srung ba gnyis kyi dang po ni/ man ngag thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas tho rangs sam zas ma zos pa'i gong du skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song nas/ rang rje btsun bir+wa pa man ngag bzhin bsgoms la/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du chu gtsang ma nyung zad blugs pa de la dmigs la/ 'di skor gyi sngags 'di rnams slar dpe dag nges rnyed na bsdur dgos/ gho ṭo/ gho ṭo/ gho ṭo/ pi yi tha/ rbarma/ piṃ tu/ mo si par/ ten dhe'u/ mo hur/ harti/ rbo yi tha/ no yi ta/ harka the/ neyi/ bhe thu/ phu ṭa/ ku gyan/ bi gyan/ pu lu/ pags rdzag dha na/ na la ke mo hur/ ming 'jug aṃ ghe/ sarba gho ṭo ka ro/ mu hur ti no/ rba ra ṭa yi yi ni/ dzu gi ni/ na yin po sha ka ra/ na ro pa a/ rgyang e ke'i sa/ sa li ya/ a nu kha yad dza tsad+dhu/ pu ru rdzu/ tu sha kha hi'o// shu ru ku ru pa/ zhes pa'i mo hur zhes pa'i skabs su rang gi ming bcug la/ lan bdun nam bcu la sogs pa bzlas te/ mchil ma chu la btab nas 'thungs na nyin zhag de la nad gdon gyi gnod pa mi 'byung ngo*// nad dang gdon gyis zin pa sogs gzhan bsrung na yang*/ chu gtsang ma de la/ sngags bsrung bya'i ming dang spel ba bzlas nas mchil ma btab ste byin na/

nad gdon gyi gnod pa las grol bar 'gyur ro// gnyis pa srung skud ni/ rang rje btsun du bsgoms nas/ srad bu sum bsgril la rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum byas nas/ mdud pa re re la'ang*/ a karba/ iṇ+ḍa/ rba tha li/ rba ra pu le/ ra ga khe/ rban+dhu/ ti ni/ rbo 'u no/ tsa pa pi/ rba pu pir/ nar+shi gharbe/ bu hu lu rbe tha/ ro hi la tsar tsir/ a rek+ṣa tsa tur/ dza dang*/ da yik+ṣa sa nu/ dhur pho l+ye/ i pa so/ a rgyang*/ ho sa d+yu ru pa/ ghu ru pa/ zhes pa'i sngags lan gsum gsum ste dgu bzlas nas/ rang gzhan gyi mgul par bcings na gnod pa las bsrung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro// gnyis pa byad bzlog pa ni/ nyi ma gsum rang gi gos nang ma phyi nang bzlog par gyon nas/ rang thun mong gi srung 'khor gyi dbus na gnas pa'i rje btsun du bsgoms la/ chu gtsang khyor ba gang la/ si bi ru pa a rgyang*/ u lu ḍi li rbed/ ra kha tha sad thi yud thi/ dzi ka ra na tī/ tī mo ron tī/ dho sa ti pa la/ dho mi nar khi/ tsan+dhu/ su ru rdzu/ tu mi sha lī/ si bi ru pa la rgyang*/ u lu ḍi li rbed/ ra kha tha sad thi/ yud thi/ dzi ka ran tā+-i/ sarba sid tī/ rbi dhu ku rgyang na hi/ mo hur/ harti rbo yi tha/ am̐ ge e haṃ/ sa li ya/ a nang gi dza/ badz+ra dzu gi ni/ a li tu sha tu nu/ zhes lan gsum bzlas pa btab nas 'thung*/ yang chu khyor ba gang la gong gi sngags lan bdun btab ste/ gos phyi nang bsgyur ba la byug de nas rang rje btsun du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas me stag tsha zhing rtsub pa dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ byad stems dang*/ ngan sngags kyi 'khrul 'khor sogs gnod pa thams cad bsreg par bsams la/ bi rū pa zhes sogs drag tu bzlas nas/ nyi ma gsum song ba dang*/ gos ci bder gyon na byad bzlog pa'i mchog tu 'gyur ro// rje btsan bir+wa pa/ rnal 'byor pa dz+nyā na dh+wa dza dang*/ bud+dha shrī bha dra rnams las brgyud pa'i man ngag zab mo 'di bla ma'i gsung bzhin shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos yi ger bkod pa'o// snod min rnams la gsang ngo*/// /

༄// yang de dang lam 'bras mtshan mtshon sbyar ba bzhugs// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ dpal ldan chos skyong bir+wa pa'i// zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal nas// de yi man ngag khyad par can// zhal shes rim pa gsal bar bri// rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po bir+wa pa'i man ngag thun mong ma yin pa snyan brgyud gcig brgyud ma 'dis gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i man ngag rnams mtshon par nus te/ 'di la gnyis/ snang ba gsum gyi bkri ba dang*/ rgyud gsum gyis bkri ba'o// dang po la gsum las/ ma dag pa'i snang ba ni/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bstan te/ der gnas pa'i sems can ngan song gsum la sogs pa'i rnam par gnas pa rnams kyi khams la brtags pas 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs shes pas/ thog mar 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa dang*/ de dag kyang rgyu mi dge ba spyad pa las 'bras bu sdug bsngal de lta bu 'byung bar shes pas/ las rgyu 'bras bsam pa dang*/ sdug bsngal de dag las thar pa'i dal 'byor gyi lus rnyed par dka' bar shes nas/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam pa rnams 'byung bas so// gnyis pa nyams kyi snang ba la gnyis/ thun mong gi nyams kyi snang ba dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams kyi snang ba'o// dang po la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems gsum gyi dang po ni/ ri dwags kṛṣ+ṇa sā ra'i pags pa'i gdan gyis bstan te/ byams pa'i sems kyis bdud dang mu stegs dang phyir rgol ba rnams btul nas bstan pa'i sgor 'jug par mdzad pas so// gnyis pa ni/ pad+mas bstan te/ pad+ma 'dam na gnas kyang des ma gos pa ltar// sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje'ang rang don yid byed kyi dri mas ma gos pa'o// gsum pa la kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems ni/ zla bas bstan te/ de gnyis chos mtshungs par rgyud 'grel las bshad pa'i phyir ro// don dam byang chub sems ni nyi mas bstan te/ de gnyis ka rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bas so// gnyis pa ni/

rje btsun gyi skur bsgoms pas bstan te/ mthu stobs kyi mgon po rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa/ stong pa dang snying rje zung du 'jug pas sku mdog dmar nag chos thams cad de bzhin nyid du gcig pas zhal gcig bden pa gnyis kyi rang bzhin gyi phyag gnyis/ kā li dang thabs dang*/ bskyed rim kyi rang bzhin phyag g.yas pas ro ma 'dzin rtog rak+ta rnams thur la mnan pa'i phyir sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'i rtse mo gug pas nyi ma stod la mnan te chang gteng bcug pa/ ā li dang shes rab dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi rang bzhin phyag g.yon pas rkyang ma gzung rtog ga pur mnan cing rlung sems gyen du bskyod de gaṅgā lan gsum bzlog pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ rtsa sna tshogs mdud pa zung 'jug bzhi'i sbyor bas rgyal po rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa/ rlung sems spyi bor 'dren pas lus sgrim/ zhal spyan bgrad pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ rlung dang byang sems kyis lus thams cad khyab pas rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ nyi zla haṃ la thim pas me tog sna tshogs kyis thod bcings pa'o// gsum pa ni/ smin mtshams kyi thad ka'i srung 'khor gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa'i nang na kye rdor lha dgu bzhugs pas bstan te/ de dag 'bras bu sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo yin pas so// gsum pa rgyud gsum gyis bkri ba la gsum/ sbyang gzhi rgyu'i rgyud/ sbyong byed thabs kyi rgyud/ grub pa 'bras bu'i rgyud do// dang po ni/ rgyab kyi dpag bsam gyi shing gis bstan te/ ji ltar dpag bsam gyi shing bzang po smon lam gyi rkyen dang phrad na ci 'dod pa'i don rnams bsam pa tsam gyis 'byung ba ltar/ kun gzhi rgyu'i rgyud nyid kyang dag pa'i rkyen dang phrad na 'bras bu sangs rgyas 'byung bas so// gnyis pa la gnyis/ shes rab lta bas thag bcad pa dang*/ thabs nyams su blangs pa'o// dang po ni/

mdun gyi ḍā ma rus bstan te/ ji ltar ḍā ma ru'i khog pa'i shing dang*/ pags pa dang*/ steng g.yogs dang*/ skyes bu'i lag pa'i rtsol ba rnams tshogs pa las glo bur du sgra skad 'byung la/ dpyad na khog pa dang*/ pags pa la sogs pa re re la yang mi gnas pa ltar/ chos thams cad kyang kun rdzob tu rgyu rkyen tshogs pa tsam dang*/ don dam par dpyad na rang bzhin mi dmigs pa shes rab ḍā ma ru'i sgra/ zhes pas so// gnyis pa la bzhi las/ dang po bum dbang dang de'i lam bskyed rim sogs ni/ g.yas kyi bum pa bdud rtsis gang bas bstan te/ ji ltar bum pa'i nang gi chus skyes bu'i lus kyi dri ma 'khrud pa ltar/ bum dbang dang bskyed pa'i rim pas kyang lus kyi dri ma 'khrud cing sgrib pa sbyong bas so// gnyis pa gsang dbang dang de'i lam rang byin rlabs sogs ni/ bum pa'i steng gi thod pa bdud rtsis gang bas bstan te/ ji ltar bdud rtsi ni a mṛ ta ste 'chi ba med pa yin pa ltar/ rlung gi sbyor ba bdun gyis kyang 'chi med sgrub pas so// thod pa ni ka pā la ste/ bde ba skyong ba yin pa ltar/ gtum mo dang thig le'i rnal 'byor la brten nas bde ba skyong bas so// gsum pa shes rab ye shes dang*/ de'i lam dkyil 'khor 'khor lo sogs ni/ g.yon gyi rig ma gdugs 'dzin pas bstan te/ dngos sam ye shes kyi rig ma la brten nas/ nyon mongs pa'i tshad pa las skyob pas so// bzhi pa dbang bzhi pa dang de'i lam rdo rje rba rlabs sogs ni/ mdun gyi tri shū las bstan te/ rba rlabs gsum gyis dug gsum bcom pas so// gsum pa ni/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug nyid kyi sku lus la rtsa gsum dang 'khor lo lnga gsal gdab pas bsten te/ rtsa dbu ma chos sku/ ro ma longs sku/ rkyang ma sprul sku ste sku gsum dang*/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de bzhin du mgrin par so sor rtog pa/

snying gar chos dbyings/ lte bar mnyam pa nyid/ gsang gnas su bya ba grub pa'i ye shes te/ ye shes lnga dag pas so/ de ltar na mtshon byed rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi man ngag 'dis mtshon bya lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag thams cad shes par nus pa 'di ni/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag yin no// tshul 'di dam pa'i zhal shes ltar// dge slong kun dga' bzang pos bris// dge bas sems can ma lus kun// mthu stobs dbang phyug nyid gyur cig /dbang thob dam tshig sdom par ldan// gsung ngag khrid kyis smin byas pa'i// snod ldan gcig brgyud ma gtogs pa// gzhan la ma spel sa ma yā/// / ༄// yang bir srung gsar ma bzhugs// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ dpal ldan mthu stobs dbang phyug dang*// dbyer med rje btsun sa skya pa// yab sras rnams la gus btud nas// gsang ba'i zhal gdams yi ge bri// byin rlabs dang man ngag thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed dang tshad med pa bzhi bsgom sngon du song nas/ oṃ swa bhā was stong par bsams pa'i ngang las dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su/ ri dwags kṛṣ+ṇa sā ra'i pags pa'i gdan gyi steng du/ pad+ma dang*/ zla ba dang*/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ rang skad cig gis rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'i rtse mo cung zad gug pa/ g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rgyab kyis dpag bsam gyi shing la sku lus brten pa/ rgyal po rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs shing sku lus sgrim pa/ zhal dang spyan bgrad cing ljags 'dril ba/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan zhing*/ me tog sna tshogs kyis thod bcings pa/ de'i rgyab tu dpag bsam gyi shing bzang po/ mdun du tri shū la gyen du 'greng ba la ḍā ma ru dpyangs pa/

g.yas su bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i steng du thod pa bdud rtsis gang bas brgyan pa/ g.yon du rig ma mtshan ldan gyis gdugs 'dzin pa/ smin mtshams kyi thad kar srung 'khor gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das kye'i rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa bsgoms nas/ rang gi lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma chos bzhi ldan/ g.yas su ro ma/ g.yon rkyang ma ste rtsa gsum bsam pa'i spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga lte ba gsang gnas rnams su pho brang lnga'i lha'i sa bon bsams te/ dkyil 'khor lnga la btud de bskrun// ces pa'i don to// de nas rlung kha sbyar du bya ba ni/ srog rtsol 'gog pa'i sbyor ba yi// zhes pa'i don to// de nas bshang sgo'i rlung gis lte ba'i me sbar/ g.yas ro ma'i nang nas zhugs/ 'khor lo rnams mas rim gyis gsal gdab/ me de spyi bo'i haṃ la reg pas/ de las byang chub kyi sems g.yon rkyang ma nas 'bab 'khor lo rnams yas rim gyis gsal btab pa'i mthar ro rkyang gnyis kyi rlung dang byang chub kyi sems rnams dbu ma'i mar sna nas zhugs te/ rlung sems thig le thams cad dbu mar thim par bsgoms la bum pa can thub tshad du byas te/ 'bar g.yo brtan pa la brten nas// zhes pa'i don to// de ltar rlung sems dbu mar zhugs pas bde stong zung 'jug gi nyams skye bar 'gyur te/ bde chen chos sku'i nam mkha' mthong*// zhes pa'i don to// de ltar rlung kha sbyor mang du byas pa'i mthar srung ba rnams byas la/ de las byung ba'i dge ba sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo bar bya zhing lta bas rgyas gdab par bya'o// rje btsun gsung rab nyi 'od kyis gsung ngag pad tshal kha phyes nas// bdag blo bung bas legs 'thungs pas// man ngag sbrang rtsi'i ro 'di byung*// 'di yang dge slong bsam gtan pa// kun dga' bzang pos man ngag rnams// brjed pas skrag nas yi ger bkod// dge des 'gro kun sangs rgyas shog

/'di'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun bir+wa pa chen po/ dpal ldan sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po/ bla ma tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ chos rje brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma rin po che dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub pa'i dbang phyug bud+dha shrī rnams so// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
